SECTION 2.1 · 教材 p.61SECTION 2.1 · Textbook p.61

傅里叶级数Fourier series

练习这一节 →Practice this section →
知识点 Concept 理解后再记忆Understand before memorizing

傅里叶级数：为什么这样做Fourier series: why the method works

先用一句话理解Begin with the idea

一条周期曲线可以拆成许多简单的正弦和余弦。积分得到的系数，就在回答“每一种波要放多少”。先确认周期和奇偶性。

A periodic curve can be built from sine and cosine waves. Each coefficient says how much of one wave is needed. Identify the period and parity before integrating.

再看数学表述Open the mathematical explanation＋

把一个周期内的函数投影到正交的正弦、余弦上；每个系数衡量对应频率的成分。端点条件决定用正弦、余弦还是半整数频率。

Project one period of a function onto orthogonal sines and cosines. Each coefficient measures the amount of one frequency. Endpoint conditions tell us whether to use sine, cosine, or half-integer frequencies.

f(x)~a02+∑n=1∞(ancosnπxl+bnsinnπxl)
使用条件When it applies

周期为 2l；分段光滑时，连续点收敛到函数值，跳跃点收敛到左右极限平均值。

The period is 2l. For a piecewise smooth function, the series converges to the function at continuity points and to the average of the one-sided limits at jumps.

展开分步证明 / 推导Open the step-by-step proof / derivation＋
  1. 第 1 步Step 1

    先理解“取出一个系数”：在 [−l,l] 上，不同频率的乘积积分为零，例如 ∫−llcos(nπx/l)cos(mπx/l)dx=0（n≠m）。

    To extract one coefficient, use orthogonality on [−l,l]: ∫−llcos(nπx/l)cos(mπx/l)dx=0 for n≠m, while the same-frequency squared integral is l.

  2. 第 2 步Step 2

    同频的平方积分则为 l。

    Product-to-sum identities verify these integrals.

  3. 第 3 步Step 3

    这些等式可由积化和差逐项积分验证。

    Multiply the expansion by cos(mπx/l) and integrate.

  4. 第 4 步Step 4

    将展开式两边乘 cos(mπx/l) 并积分。

    Sines, the constant, and other frequencies vanish, leaving aml.

  5. 第 5 步Step 5

    正弦项、常数项和其他频率都消失，只留下 aml。

    Thus am=1l∫−llf(x)cos(mπx/l)dx, m≥1.

  6. 第 6 步Step 6

    因此 am=1l∫−llf(x)cos(mπx/l)dx，m≥1。

    To extract a sine coefficient, multiply by sin(mπx/l) instead, giving bm=1l∫−llf(x)sin(mπx/l)dx.

  7. 第 7 步Step 7

    要取正弦系数，就改乘 sin(mπx/l)，得到 bm=1l∫−llf(x)sin(mπx/l)dx。

    Integrating the expansion itself gives a0=1l∫−llf(x)dx; the constant is a0/2.

  8. 第 8 步Step 8

    直接积分原展开式则给 a0=1l∫−llf(x)dx；常数项是 a0/2。

    This derives projection coefficients, not the convergence theorem.

  9. 第 9 步Step 9

    以上是系数的投影推导，不是收敛定理的证明。

    Apply orthogonality to finite sums and then pass to an appropriate square-integrable limit.

  10. 第 10 步Step 10

    可先对有限和使用正交关系，再在平方可积意义下取极限；要判断某点的和，还需使用分段光滑函数的傅里叶收敛定理，跳跃点取左右平均。

    Pointwise sums require the Fourier convergence theorem for piecewise smooth functions; jumps give the average of the side limits.

做一道简单例题：按步骤看计算Worked example: follow each calculation＋
题目Problem

把 f(x)=x 在区间 (−π,π) 上展开成傅里叶级数。

Expand f(x)=x in a Fourier series on (−π,π).

已知什么Given

采用 f(x)=a02+∑n=1∞[ancos(nx)+bnsin(nx)]。系数在 (−π,π) 上计算。

Use f(x)=a02+∑n=1∞[ancos(nx)+bnsin(nx)]. Compute the coefficients on (−π,π).

要求什么Find

利用奇偶性减少积分，再算出所有非零系数。

Use parity to reduce the integrations, then compute every nonzero coefficient.

  1. 第 1 步Step 1先看奇偶性Check parity first
    为什么这样做Why this step

    奇偶性可以不用积分就消去一半系数。

    Parity removes half the coefficients without integration.

    具体怎么算Calculation

    f(x)=x 是奇函数，所以 a0=0，并且 an=1π∫−ππxcos(nx)dx=0。

    f(x)=x is odd, so a0=0 and an=1π∫−ππxcos(nx)dx=0.

  2. 第 2 步Step 2写出正弦系数Write the sine coefficient
    为什么这样做Why this step

    xsin(nx) 是偶函数，可把对称区间积分化成两倍半区间积分。

    xsin(nx) is even, so a symmetric-interval integral becomes twice the half-interval integral.

    具体怎么算Calculation

    bn=1π∫−ππxsin(nx)dx=2π∫0πxsin(nx)dx。

  3. 第 3 步Step 3做分部积分Integrate by parts
    为什么这样做Why this step

    积分中含有 x 乘三角函数，分部积分可以去掉 x。

    The integrand is x times a trigonometric function, so integration by parts removes x.

    具体怎么算Calculation

    ∫0πxsin(nx)dx=[−xcos(nx)n]0π+1n∫0πcos(nx)dx=−π(−1)nn。

  4. 第 4 步Step 4得到系数Obtain the coefficient
    为什么这样做Why this step

    把刚算出的积分乘回系数公式中的 2/π。

    Multiply the integral just found by the factor 2/π in the coefficient formula.

    具体怎么算Calculation

    bn=2π[−π(−1)nn]=2(−1)n+1n。

  5. 第 5 步Step 5写出最终级数Write the final series
    为什么这样做Why this step

    只有正弦项非零，把 bn 代回原展开式即可。

    Only sine terms remain, so substitute bn into the original expansion.

    具体怎么算Calculation

    x=2∑n=1∞(−1)n+1nsin(nx)，其中 −π<x<π；在端点级数收敛到 0。

    x=2∑n=1∞(−1)n+1nsin(nx) for −π<x<π; at the endpoints the series converges to 0.

做完以后这样检查Check after solving

  • 右端只含正弦项，因此它是奇函数，与 f(x)=x 一致。

    The right side contains only sine terms, so it is odd like f(x)=x.

  • 取 n=1 得 b1=2，直接计算 2π∫0πxsinxdx 也等于 2。

    For n=1, b1=2, and direct calculation of 2π∫0πxsinxdx also gives 2.

  • 周期接缝两侧极限为 π 和 −π，平均值是 0。

    The periodic seam has side limits π and −π, whose average is 0.

学完试一题：合上例题，自己做Try it yourself: close the worked example＋

先独立写第一步。卡住时只开一个提示，做完再核对答案。Write your first step independently. Open one hint if stuck; check the solution after attempting the problem.

函数 f 的周期为 2π，在 −π<x<π 上 f(x)=1+x/2。求傅里叶级数，并判断级数在周期接缝 x=π 的和。接缝处函数自身如何定义不影响系数。

The function f has period 2π and satisfies f(x)=1+x/2 for −π<x<π. Find its Fourier series and the series sum at the periodic seam x=π. The assigned function value at the seam does not affect the coefficients.

提示 1：先选方法Hint 1: choose a method＋

把函数拆成常数部分和奇函数部分。

Split the function into a constant part and an odd part.

提示 2：写第一行Hint 2: write the first line＋

常数系数 a0=2，正余弦交叉项消失；bn=π−1∫0πxsin(nx)dx。

The constant coefficient is a0=2 and the sine-cosine cross terms vanish; bn=π−1∫0πxsin(nx)dx.

提示 3：关键计算Hint 3: key calculation＋

分部积分给 bn=(−1)n+1/n；接缝取左右极限的平均。

Integration by parts gives bn=(−1)n+1/n; take the average of the one-sided limits at the seam.

展开分步完整解答Open the full step-by-step solution＋
  1. 第 1 步Step 1

    在对称区间积分，常数部分贡献 a0=π−1∫−ππ1dx=2。

    On the symmetric interval the constant part contributes a0=π−1∫−ππ1dx=2.

  2. 第 2 步Step 2

    奇函数部分与余弦相乘仍为奇函数，所以 an=0，其中 n≥1。

    The odd part times a cosine remains odd, so an=0 for n≥1.

  3. 第 3 步Step 3

    正弦系数中常数部分消失，而奇函数乘正弦变成偶函数，因此 bn=π−1∫0πxsin(nx)dx。

    In the sine coefficient the constant part vanishes, while the odd part times a sine is even; thus bn=π−1∫0πxsin(nx)dx.

  4. 第 4 步Step 4

    分部积分得到 ∫0πxsin(nx)dx=−π(−1)n/n。

    Integration by parts gives ∫0πxsin(nx)dx=−π(−1)n/n.

  5. 第 5 步Step 5

    所以 f(x)~1+∑n=1∞(−1)n+1sin(nx)/n。

    Hence f(x)~1+∑n=1∞(−1)n+1sin(nx)/n.

  6. 第 6 步Step 6

    在开区间内，分段光滑收敛定理给出和就是原函数。

    Inside the open interval, the piecewise-smooth convergence theorem identifies the sum with the original function.

  7. 第 7 步Step 7

    在接缝，左右极限分别是 1+π/2 和 1−π/2，平均为1。

    At the seam the one-sided limits are 1+π/2 and 1−π/2, with average 1.

  8. 第 8 步Step 8

    级数在 x=π 的和因此为1，与每个正弦项都为零也一致。

    The series sum at x=π is therefore 1, also agreeing with every sine term being zero there.

怎样检查，哪里容易错Check your result and common mistakes＋

常数项是 a0/2=1，不能误写成2；接缝取平均而不是取左极限。

The constant term is a0/2=1, not 2; use the average at the seam rather than its left limit.

先看周期，再看奇偶；投影积分最后算。

Check the period, then parity. Calculate projection integrals last.

SECTION 2.2 · 教材 p.70SECTION 2.2 · Textbook p.70

傅里叶积分变换Fourier integral transforms

练习这一节 →Practice this section →
知识点 Concept 理解后再记忆Understand before memorizing

傅里叶积分变换：为什么这样做Fourier transforms: why the method works

先用一句话理解Begin with the idea

不周期的函数也能拆成频率成分，只是频率变成连续的。先抄清正、逆变换的符号与系数，再代入积分。

A nonperiodic function can also be resolved into frequencies, now continuous ones. Write the forward and inverse conventions before calculating an integral.

再看数学表述Open the mathematical explanation＋

傅里叶变换把全轴函数分解为连续频率。微分在频域变成乘 ik，局部窄脉冲对应宽频谱。本章统一正变换不带系数、逆变换带 1/(2π)。

The Fourier transform splits a whole-line function into a continuous range of frequencies. Differentiation becomes multiplication by ik in frequency space. A narrow pulse has a broad spectrum. Throughout this chapter, the forward transform has no prefactor and the inverse has 1/(2π).

F(k)=∫−∞∞f(x)e−ikxdx,f(x)=12π∫−∞∞F(k)eikxdk
使用条件When it applies

通常要求可积或平方可积；阶跃、符号函数和库仑势需按广义函数或正则化理解。

Usually require integrability or square integrability. Step functions, the sign function, and Coulomb potentials require distributions or regularization.

展开分步证明 / 推导Open the step-by-step proof / derivation＋
  1. 第 1 步Step 1

    下面推导两个常用性质，而不是完整证明傅里叶反演定理。

    We derive two useful properties here, rather than prove the full Fourier inversion theorem.

  2. 第 2 步Step 2

    先假设函数及导数足够可积，并且无穷远边界项消失，确保操作合法。

    Assume sufficient integrability of the function and derivative, and vanishing boundary terms at infinity.

  3. 第 3 步Step 3

    在 F[f′](k)=∫f′(x)e−ikxdx 中分部积分：∫f′e−ikxdx=[fe−ikx]−∞∞+ik∫fe−ikxdx。

    Integrate F[f′](k)=∫f′(x)e−ikxdx by parts: ∫f′e−ikxdx=[fe−ikx]−∞∞+ik∫fe−ikxdx.

  4. 第 4 步Step 4

    负指数求导的负号与分部积分的负号相消。

    The derivative and integration-by-parts minus signs cancel.

  5. 第 5 步Step 5

    边界项为零后，剩下 F[f′]=ikF。

    With zero boundary term, F[f′]=ikF.

  6. 第 6 步Step 6

    再求一次导数就变成 (ik)2F=−k2F，这就是偏微分方程在频域变简单的原因。

    Differentiating twice gives (ik)2F=−k2F, explaining why spatial differential equations simplify in frequency space.

  7. 第 7 步Step 7

    缩放时令 y=ax，a≠0。

    For scaling, set y=ax, a≠0.

  8. 第 8 步Step 8

    当 a<0，积分上下限反向，抵消微分元中的负号，因此 F[f(ax)](k)=|a|−1F(k/a)。

    If a<0, reversed integration limits cancel the sign in the differential.

  9. 第 9 步Step 9

    前面的绝对值不能遗漏。

    Hence F[f(ax)](k)=|a|−1F(k/a); retain the absolute value.

做一道简单例题：按步骤看计算Worked example: follow each calculation＋
题目Problem

在约定 F(k)=∫−∞∞f(x)e−ikxdx 下，求 f(x)=e−a|x| 的傅里叶变换，其中 a>0。

Under the convention F(k)=∫−∞∞f(x)e−ikxdx, find the Fourier transform of f(x)=e−a|x|, where a>0.

已知什么Given

a>0 保证函数在无穷远衰减。k 是实频率变量。

a>0 ensures decay at infinity. k is the real frequency variable.

要求什么Find

利用偶性把积分减半，再算出显式的频谱。

Use evenness to halve the work, then compute the spectrum explicitly.

  1. 第 1 步Step 1利用函数的偶性Use evenness
    为什么这样做Why this step

    偶函数乘正弦得到奇函数，虚部在对称区间积分为零。

    An even function times sine is odd, so the imaginary part integrates to zero on a symmetric interval.

    具体怎么算Calculation

    f(x) 是实偶函数，因此 F(k)=2∫0∞e−axcos(kx)dx。

    f(x) is real and even, so F(k)=2∫0∞e−axcos(kx)dx.

  2. 第 2 步Step 2改成复指数积分Use a complex exponential integral
    为什么这样做Why this step

    指数函数容易直接积分，最后只需取实部。

    The exponential is easy to integrate, and only its real part is needed afterward.

    具体怎么算Calculation

    ∫0∞e−axcos(kx)dx=Re∫0∞e−(a−ik)xdx。

  3. 第 3 步Step 3计算指数积分Evaluate the exponential integral
    为什么这样做Why this step

    a>0 使上限处的指数趋于零。

    a>0 makes the exponential vanish at the upper limit.

    具体怎么算Calculation

    ∫0∞e−(a−ik)xdx=[−e−(a−ik)xa−ik]0∞=1a−ik。

  4. 第 4 步Step 4取实部并乘二Take the real part and double
    为什么这样做Why this step

    有理化后可以直接读出实部。

    Rationalizing makes the real part visible immediately.

    具体怎么算Calculation

    1a−ik=a+ika2+k2，所以 F(k)=2aa2+k2。

    1a−ik=a+ika2+k2, so F(k)=2aa2+k2.

做完以后这样检查Check after solving

  • F(k) 是实偶函数，符合实偶原函数的变换性质。

    F(k) is real and even, as expected for a real even original function.

  • F(0)=2/a，等于 ∫−∞∞e−a|x|dx=2/a。

    F(0)=2/a, equal to ∫−∞∞e−a|x|dx=2/a.

  • 当 |k|→∞ 时 F(k)→0，符合可积函数频谱衰减的预期。

    As |k|→∞, F(k)→0, as expected for the spectrum of an integrable function.

学完试一题：合上例题，自己做Try it yourself: close the worked example＋

先独立写第一步。卡住时只开一个提示，做完再核对答案。Write your first step independently. Open one hint if stuck; check the solution after attempting the problem.

设 f(x)=2（|x|≤1），其余处为零。按 F(k)=∫−∞∞f(x)e−ikxdx 求变换，并单独给出 F(0)。

Let f(x)=2 for |x|≤1 and zero elsewhere. Find the transform using F(k)=∫−∞∞f(x)e−ikxdx, and give F(0) separately.

提示 1：先选方法Hint 1: choose a method＋

函数是偶函数，变换中的正弦虚部积分为零。

The function is even, so the sine contribution to the transform integrates to zero.

提示 2：写第一行Hint 2: write the first line＋

变换化为 F(k)=4∫01cos(kx)dx。

The transform reduces to F(k)=4∫01cos(kx)dx.

提示 3：关键计算Hint 3: key calculation＋

对 k≠0 积分得 4sink/k；在零频率直接算面积。

For k≠0, integration gives 4sink/k; at zero frequency compute the area directly.

展开分步完整解答Open the full step-by-step solution＋
  1. 第 1 步Step 1

    只有区间内有贡献，所以 F(k)=2∫−11e−ikxdx。

    Only the finite interval contributes, so F(k)=2∫−11e−ikxdx.

  2. 第 2 步Step 2

    把指数拆成余弦和正弦，正弦部分因奇偶性消失。

    Split the exponential into cosine and sine; oddness eliminates the sine part.

  3. 第 3 步Step 3

    剩下的余弦是偶函数，得到 F(k)=4∫01cos(kx)dx。

    The remaining cosine is even, giving F(k)=4∫01cos(kx)dx.

  4. 第 4 步Step 4

    当 k≠0，原函数为 sin(kx)/k，因此 F(k)=4sink/k。

    For k≠0, its antiderivative is sin(kx)/k, hence F(k)=4sink/k.

  5. 第 5 步Step 5

    在 k=0 时不直接除以零，而用原积分得到 F(0)=2∫−11dx=4。

    At k=0 do not divide by zero; return to the original integral to get F(0)=2∫−11dx=4.

  6. 第 6 步Step 6

    这也等于上一表达式在零点的极限，故零点是可去的。

    This also equals the limit of the previous expression, so the zero-frequency singularity is removable.

怎样检查，哪里容易错Check your result and common mistakes＋

检查 F(0)=4 等于矩形面积，且频谱为实偶函数。常见错误：在本章正变换中多乘 1/(2π)。

Check that F(0)=4 equals the rectangle area and that the spectrum is real and even. A common error is adding 1/(2π) to the forward transform in this convention.

记忆线索Memory cue

正变换负指数，逆变换正指数；乘积与卷积的 2π 别丢。

Use a negative exponential for the forward transform and a positive one for the inverse. Keep track of 2π in product and convolution formulas.

知识点 Concept 理解后再记忆Understand before memorizing

Fourier 变换的平移、微分与卷积Shifts, derivatives, and convolution in Fourier transforms

先用一句话理解Begin with the idea

平移、求导、卷积各有对应的变换规则，可以省掉长积分。先辨认题目做了哪一种操作，再核对符号和系数。

Translation, differentiation, and convolution have transform rules that save integration. Identify the operation first, then check its sign and normalization.

再看数学表述Open the mathematical explanation＋

变换把空间微分变成代数乘法，把卷积变成乘积。使用性质前，先确认指数正负号和 2π 放在哪一侧。

The transform turns spatial derivatives into algebraic multiplication and convolutions into products. Before using a property, check the exponential sign and which side contains 2π.

f′^=ikF,f(x−a)^=e−ikaF,f*g^=FG,fg^=F*G2π
使用条件When it applies

规范为 F(k)=∫f(x)e−ikxdx、f(x)=(2π)−1∫F(k)eikxdk。普通函数需有足够可积性、可换序且分部积分端点消失；分布情形按定义推广。

The convention is F(k)=∫f(x)e−ikxdx and f(x)=(2π)−1∫F(k)eikxdk. For ordinary functions, require sufficient integrability, justified interchange of integrals, and vanishing integration-by-parts boundary terms. Distributional versions follow by definition.

展开分步证明 / 推导Open the step-by-step proof / derivation＋

微分：对 ∫f′(x)e−ikxdx 分部积分，边界项消失后留下 ikF(k)；这一步要求相应衰减条件。

平移：令 y=x−a，则 x=y+a，所以 e−ikx=e−ikae−iky；与 y 无关的因子提到积分外，得到 e−ikaF(k)。

卷积：先写 (f*g)(x)=∫f(s)g(x−s)ds。

在二重积分中令 y=x−s，指数拆成 e−ikse−iky，因此两个积分分离为 F(k)G(k)。

乘积：将 f(x)=12π∫F(q)eiqxdq 代入变换，交换积分后，内层是 G(k−q)。

留下 12π∫F(q)G(k−q)dq。

这里的系数来自逆变换。

Differentiation: integrate ∫f′(x)e−ikxdx by parts.

Under the required decay conditions, the boundary term vanishes and leaves ikF(k).

Translation: set y=x−a, so x=y+a and e−ikx=e−ikae−iky.

Pull out the factor independent of y to obtain e−ikaF(k).

Convolution: write (f*g)(x)=∫f(s)g(x−s)ds.

In the double integral put y=x−s, splitting the exponential as e−ikse−iky.

The two integrals separate into F(k)G(k).

Product: substitute f(x)=12π∫F(q)eiqxdq into the transform.

After interchanging integrals, the inner one is G(k−q), leaving 12π∫F(q)G(k−q)dq.

Its prefactor comes from inversion.

做一道简单例题：按步骤看计算Worked example: follow each calculation＋
题目Problem

已知 e−x2^=πe−k2/4，求 g(x)=e−(x−a)2 的傅里叶变换。

Given e−x2^=πe−k2/4, find the Fourier transform of g(x)=e−(x−a)2.

已知什么Given

采用 f^(k)=∫−∞∞f(x)e−ikxdx，并设 a 为实常数。

Use f^(k)=∫−∞∞f(x)e−ikxdx, and let a be real.

要求什么Find

识别平移并得到含相位因子的频谱。

Recognize the translation and obtain the spectrum with its phase factor.

  1. 第 1 步Step 1识别原函数和平移Identify the original function and shift
    为什么这样做Why this step

    题目已给标准高斯的变换，不需要重新完成高斯积分。

    The transform of the standard Gaussian is already given, so the Gaussian integral need not be repeated.

    具体怎么算Calculation

    令 f(x)=e−x2，则 g(x)=f(x−a)，表示图像向右平移 a。

    Let f(x)=e−x2; then g(x)=f(x−a), which shifts the graph right by a.

  2. 第 2 步Step 2从定义换元Substitute in the definition
    为什么这样做Why this step

    换元能看清平移如何变成指数因子。

    A substitution shows exactly how the translation becomes an exponential factor.

    具体怎么算Calculation

    G(k)=∫−∞∞f(x−a)e−ikxdx；令 u=x−a，则 x=u+a、dx=du。

    G(k)=∫−∞∞f(x−a)e−ikxdx; let u=x−a, so x=u+a and dx=du.

  3. 第 3 步Step 3提出与积分无关的因子Take out the constant factor
    为什么这样做Why this step

    e−ika 不含积分变量，可以移到积分号外。

    e−ika contains no integration variable, so it can be moved outside the integral.

    具体怎么算Calculation

    G(k)=e−ika∫−∞∞f(u)e−ikudu=e−ikaF(k)。

  4. 第 4 步Step 4代入已知高斯变换Insert the known Gaussian transform
    为什么这样做Why this step

    把题目给出的 F(k) 直接放入平移公式。

    Substitute the supplied F(k) into the translation formula.

    具体怎么算Calculation

    G(k)=e−ikaπe−k2/4。

做完以后这样检查Check after solving

  • |e−ika|=1，所以平移前后频谱的模相同。

    |e−ika|=1, so translation leaves the spectrum magnitude unchanged.

  • 令 a=0，结果退化为 πe−k2/4。

    For a=0, the result reduces to πe−k2/4.

  • 令 k=0，得到 G(0)=π，与高斯函数的总面积不随平移改变一致。

    For k=0, G(0)=π, consistent with translation preserving the total area of a Gaussian.

学完试一题：合上例题，自己做Try it yourself: close the worked example＋

先独立写第一步。卡住时只开一个提示，做完再核对答案。Write your first step independently. Open one hint if stuck; check the solution after attempting the problem.

已知在正变换负指数的规范下，e−x2^=πe−k2/4。求 g(x)=ddxe−(x−2)2 的傅里叶变换 G(k)，并写出 g(x) 的普通表达式。

In the negative-exponent forward-transform convention, suppose e−x2^=πe−k2/4. Find the Fourier transform G(k) of g(x)=ddxe−(x−2)2, and write an ordinary expression for g(x).

提示 1：先选方法Hint 1: choose a method＋

连续用两个性质：空间平移产生相位，空间导数产生 ik。

Apply two properties: spatial translation gives a phase and spatial differentiation gives ik.

提示 2：写第一行Hint 2: write the first line＋

令 h(x)=e−(x−2)2，先得 H(k)=e−2ikπe−k2/4。

Set h(x)=e−(x−2)2; first obtain H(k)=e−2ikπe−k2/4.

提示 3：关键计算Hint 3: key calculation＋

再用 G(k)=ikH(k)；高斯函数衰减使分部积分边界项为零。

Next use G(k)=ikH(k); Gaussian decay makes the integration-by-parts boundary term zero.

展开分步完整解答Open the full step-by-step solution＋

先认出 h(x)=f(x−2)，其中 f(x)=e−x2。

平移距离为正2，因此相位是 e−2ik，得到 H(k)=e−2ikπe−k2/4。

现在 g=h′。

分部积分中两端的高斯函数趋零，故导数的变换等于 ik 乘原变换，答案为 G(k)=ike−2ikπe−k2/4。

对原函数用链式法则，还可写成 g(x)=−2(x−2)e−(x−2)2。

注意这个式子的负号已经包含在求导规则里，不能再给频域结果随意加负号。

Recognize h(x)=f(x−2) with f(x)=e−x2.

The positive translation by 2 gives the phase e−2ik, so H(k)=e−2ikπe−k2/4.

Now g=h′.

The Gaussian tends to zero at both integration endpoints, so integration by parts makes the derivative transform ik times the original transform.

Thus G(k)=ike−2ikπe−k2/4.

The chain rule in real space also gives g(x)=−2(x−2)e−(x−2)2.

Its minus sign is already accounted for by the derivative rule; do not add another minus sign to the frequency-space answer.

怎样检查，哪里容易错Check your result and common mistakes＋

零频率检查：G(0)=0，因为 ∫−∞∞g(x)dx=h(∞)−h(−∞)=0。关联题用于复习变换性质，不是该题的同题重做。

Zero-frequency check: G(0)=0 because ∫−∞∞g(x)dx=h(∞)−h(−∞)=0. The linked exercise reviews transform properties; this is a separate practice problem.

A spatial shift adds phase. A derivative multiplies by ik. A convolution becomes a product.

SECTION 2.3 · 教材 p.76SECTION 2.3 · Textbook p.76

δ 函数简介Introduction to the δ distribution

练习这一节 →Practice this section →
知识点 Concept 理解后再记忆Understand before memorizing

δ 函数与抽样性质The δ distribution and sampling

先用一句话理解Begin with the idea

δ不是普通的尖峰函数，而是“在指定位置取值”的积分规则。遇到缩放先处理绝对值系数，遇到导数先处理负号。

Delta is an integration rule that samples a value at one point. For scaling, handle the absolute-value factor; for a derivative, handle the minus sign.

再看数学表述Open the mathematical explanation＋

δ 应看作作用在测试函数上的抽样规则，不能当作普通的“某点等于无穷大”的函数进行逐点运算。单位面积且不断变窄的脉冲可以逼近它。

Think of δ as a sampling rule acting on test functions. It is not an ordinary function that can be manipulated pointwise as “infinite at one point.” Pulses with unit area and shrinking width can approach it.

∫δ(x−a)φ(x)dx=φ(a),δ(g(x))=∑g(xj)=0δ(x−xj)|g′(xj)|
使用条件When it applies

后一公式要求根为单根；积分区间须包含相应根。

The second formula requires simple roots. The integration interval must contain the relevant roots.

展开分步证明 / 推导Open the step-by-step proof / derivation＋

先说明单根为什么重要。

若 g(xj)=0 且 g′(xj)≠0，在该根附近可以反解 x=x(u)，其中 u=g(x)；反函数的导数不会发散。

在测试函数积分里换元，微分元带来 1/|g′(x(u))|。

绝对值把根附近的方向反转也包括进去；不能直接除以带符号的导数。

然后由 δ(u) 在 u=0 抽样，该根贡献为 φ(xj)/|g′(xj)|。

对所有位于积分区间内的单根相加，即得到公式。

若出现重根 g′(xj)=0，这个换元失效，不能把公式中的分母写成零后继续计算。

根在区间外则不贡献；根在端点时还需说明约定。

A simple root matters because g(xj)=0 and g′(xj)≠0 allow a local inverse x=x(u) with u=g(x) and a finite inverse derivative.

Changing variables inside a test-function integral introduces 1/|g′(x(u))|.

The absolute value accounts for orientation reversal near a root; do not divide by a signed derivative.

δ(u) samples at u=0, so this root contributes φ(xj)/|g′(xj)|.

Sum the contributions of all simple roots within the integration interval.

For a multiple root with g′(xj)=0, the substitution fails; the formula cannot be used by dividing by zero.

Roots outside the interval contribute nothing, while endpoint roots require a stated convention.

做一道简单例题：按步骤看计算Worked example: follow each calculation＋
题目Problem

计算 ∫−22(1+x2)δ(x2−1)dx。

Evaluate ∫−22(1+x2)δ(x2−1)dx.

已知什么Given

若 g(xi)=0 且 g′(xi)≠0，则 δ(g(x))=∑iδ(x−xi)|g′(xi)|。只保留积分区间内的根。

If g(xi)=0 and g′(xi)≠0, then δ(g(x))=∑iδ(x−xi)|g′(xi)|. Keep only roots inside the integration interval.

要求什么Find

找全零点，计算导数权重，再使用抽样性质。

Find every root, compute the derivative weights, and apply the sampling property.

  1. 第 1 步Step 1求根号内函数的零点Find the zeros of the inner function
    为什么这样做Why this step

    δ(g(x)) 只会在 g(x)=0 的位置产生贡献。

    δ(g(x)) contributes only where g(x)=0.

    具体怎么算Calculation

    令 g(x)=x2−1，解 g(x)=0 得 x1=1、x2=−1，两点都在 [−2,2] 内。

    Let g(x)=x2−1; solving g(x)=0 gives x1=1 and x2=−1, both inside [−2,2].

  2. 第 2 步Step 2计算每个根的权重Compute the weight at each root
    为什么这样做Why this step

    复合变量的 δ 函数必须除以导数绝对值。

    A composite δ function must be divided by the absolute derivative.

    具体怎么算Calculation

    g′(x)=2x，所以 |g′(1)|=2、|g′(−1)|=2。

    g′(x)=2x, so |g′(1)|=2 and |g′(−1)|=2.

  3. 第 3 步Step 3展开复合 $\delta$ 函数Expand the composite $\delta$ function
    为什么这样做Why this step

    把它写成普通点质量后即可逐点抽样。

    Writing it as ordinary point masses makes direct sampling possible.

    具体怎么算Calculation

    δ(x2−1)=δ(x−1)2+δ(x+1)2。

  4. 第 4 步Step 4代入两个抽样点Evaluate at both sampling points
    为什么这样做Why this step

    每个 δ 项把权函数 1+x2 取在自己的根上。

    Each δ term evaluates the weight 1+x2 at its own root.

    具体怎么算Calculation

    ∫−22(1+x2)δ(x2−1)dx=1+122+1+(−1)22=1+1=2。

做完以后这样检查Check after solving

  • 两个根都在积分区间内，不能漏掉 x=−1。

    Both roots lie in the integration interval, so x=−1 must not be omitted.

  • 两个权重都含 |g′(xi)|=2，绝对值保证权重为正。

    Both weights contain |g′(xi)|=2, and the absolute value keeps them positive.

  • 被积权函数在两个根处都等于 2，最终两个贡献相等。

    The weight function equals 2 at both roots, so the two final contributions are equal.

学完试一题：合上例题，自己做Try it yourself: close the worked example＋

先独立写第一步。卡住时只开一个提示，做完再核对答案。Write your first step independently. Open one hint if stuck; check the solution after attempting the problem.

计算 I=∫−33(x+4)δ(x2−4)dx。所有零点都在区间内部；使用单根公式时说明每个根的权重。

Evaluate I=∫−33(x+4)δ(x2−4)dx. All zeros lie strictly inside the interval; state the weight at each root when applying the simple-root rule.

提示 1：先选方法Hint 1: choose a method＋

先解 x2−4=0，不要只取正根。

First solve x2−4=0; do not retain only the positive root.

提示 2：写第一行Hint 2: write the first line＋

两根是 x=2,−2，且 g′(x)=2x 在两根都非零。

The roots are x=2,−2, and g′(x)=2x is nonzero at both.

提示 3：关键计算Hint 3: key calculation＋

绝对导数均为4，因此两贡献为 6/4 与 2/4。

The absolute derivative equals 4 at each root, giving contributions 6/4 and 2/4.

展开分步完整解答Open the full step-by-step solution＋
  1. 第 1 步Step 1

    令 g(x)=x2−4。

    Set g(x)=x2−4.

  2. 第 2 步Step 2

    零点是 x=2,−2，都位于积分区间内部。

    Its roots are x=2,−2, both strictly inside the integration interval.

  3. 第 3 步Step 3

    又因 g′(2)=4、g′(−2)=−4，两根都是单根，可以使用换元公式。

    Since g′(2)=4 and g′(−2)=−4, both roots are simple and the change-of-variable formula applies.

  4. 第 4 步Step 4

    取导数绝对值得 δ(x2−4)=[δ(x−2)+δ(x+2)]/4。

    Taking absolute derivatives gives δ(x2−4)=[δ(x−2)+δ(x+2)]/4.

  5. 第 5 步Step 5

    负根的权重仍为正，不能直接除以负导数。

    The weight at the negative root remains positive; do not divide by a signed negative derivative.

  6. 第 6 步Step 6

    分别抽样：在正根处 x+4=6，在负根处 x+4=2。

    Sample at each root: x+4=6 at the positive root and x+4=2 at the negative root.

  7. 第 7 步Step 7

    所以 I=6/4+2/4=2。

    Thus I=6/4+2/4=2.

怎样检查，哪里容易错Check your result and common mistakes＋

检查奇函数部分 xδ(x2−4) 在对称区间积分为零，常数部分贡献为2。常见错误：漏负根或漏绝对值。

Check that the odd part xδ(x2−4) integrates to zero over the symmetric interval, while the constant part contributes 2. Common errors are missing the negative root or the absolute value.

SECTION 2.4 · 教材 p.89SECTION 2.4 · Textbook p.89

拉普拉斯变换Laplace transforms

练习这一节 →Practice this section →
知识点 Concept 理解后再记忆Understand before memorizing

拉普拉斯变换：为什么这样做Laplace transforms: why the method works

先用一句话理解Begin with the idea

拉普拉斯变换把时间函数换成关于s的函数。先把题目拆成已知变换表里的部分，再用平移或微分规则。

The Laplace transform turns a time function into a function of s. Break the expression into table entries, then apply shift or derivative rules as needed.

再看数学表述Open the mathematical explanation＋

拉普拉斯变换只看 t≥0，指数衰减因子使更多函数可变换，尤其适合初值问题。导数的变换会自动带入初值。

The Laplace transform uses only t≥0. Its decaying exponential allows a larger class of functions to be transformed and is especially useful for initial-value problems. Transforming a derivative automatically includes the initial values.

F(p)=∫0∞f(t)e−ptdt,L[f′]=pF−f(0+)
使用条件When it applies

f 分段连续且为指数阶；Rep 大于其增长率。

f is piecewise continuous and of exponential order. Rep must exceed its growth rate.

展开分步证明 / 推导Open the step-by-step proof / derivation＋

从定义出发，假设 f 及所需导数有适当的分段光滑性和指数增长界，并取 Rep 足够大，使无穷远边界项消失。

对 ∫0∞f′(t)e−ptdt 分部积分，得到 [fe−pt]0∞+p∫0∞fe−ptdt。

上限为零，下限需减去 f(0+)，因此结果为 pF−f(0+)。

对 f′ 再用一次同一公式：L[f′′]=pL[f′]−f′(0+)=p2F−pf(0+)−f′(0+)。

初位移与初速度的系数不同。

初值项不是额外记忆的补丁，它们正是积分下限留下的边界项。

做初值题时先把这些项写全，再整理代数方程。

Begin with the definition.

Assume suitable piecewise smoothness and exponential growth bounds for f and the required derivatives, and take Rep large enough to eliminate the boundary term at infinity.

Integration by parts in ∫0∞f′(t)e−ptdt gives [fe−pt]0∞+p∫0∞fe−ptdt.

The upper value is zero and the lower value f(0+) is subtracted, leaving pF−f(0+).

Apply the same formula to f′: L[f′′]=pL[f′]−f′(0+)=p2F−pf(0+)−f′(0+).

Initial displacement and velocity have different factors.

Initial-value terms are the boundary terms left by the lower integration limit.

Write them explicitly before collecting the algebraic equation in an initial-value problem.

做一道简单例题：按步骤看计算Worked example: follow each calculation＋
题目Problem

求 L[te2t]，并写出收敛条件。

Find L[te2t] and state its convergence condition.

已知什么Given

拉普拉斯变换定义为 F(p)=L[f(t)]=∫0∞e−ptf(t)dt。性质为 L[tf(t)]=−F′(p)。

The Laplace transform is F(p)=L[f(t)]=∫0∞e−ptf(t)dt. The relevant property is L[tf(t)]=−F′(p).

要求什么Find

从指数函数的已知变换出发，用求导性质得到答案。

Start from the known transform of an exponential and use the differentiation property.

  1. 第 1 步Step 1先变换指数函数Transform the exponential first
    为什么这样做Why this step

    te2t 是在 e2t 前乘了 t，所以先求后者的变换。

    te2t is e2t multiplied by t, so first transform the exponential alone.

    具体怎么算Calculation

    F(p)=L[e2t]=∫0∞e−(p−2)tdt=1p−2，条件为 Rep>2。

    F(p)=L[e2t]=∫0∞e−(p−2)tdt=1p−2, with condition Rep>2.

  2. 第 2 步Step 2使用乘 $t$ 的性质Use the multiplication-by-$t$ property
    为什么这样做Why this step

    时域乘 t 对应像函数对 p 求导并加负号。

    Multiplication by t in the time domain means differentiating with respect to p and adding a minus sign.

    具体怎么算Calculation

    L[te2t]=−F′(p)=−ddp(p−2)−1。

  3. 第 3 步Step 3完成求导Carry out the derivative
    为什么这样做Why this step

    幂函数求导产生的负号会与性质中的负号抵消。

    The minus sign from differentiating the power cancels the minus sign in the property.

    具体怎么算Calculation

    ddp(p−2)−1=−(p−2)−2，所以 L[te2t]=1(p−2)2。

    ddp(p−2)−1=−(p−2)−2, so L[te2t]=1(p−2)2.

  4. 第 4 步Step 4保留收敛条件Keep the convergence condition
    为什么这样做Why this step

    多项式因子 t 不会改变由指数增长率决定的收敛边界。

    The polynomial factor t does not change the boundary set by exponential growth.

    具体怎么算Calculation

    最终结果是 L[te2t]=1(p−2)2，仍要求 Rep>2。

    The final result is L[te2t]=1(p−2)2, still requiring Rep>2.

做完以后这样检查Check after solving

  • 直接令 q=p−2，可得 ∫0∞te−qtdt=1/q2。

    Setting q=p−2 directly gives ∫0∞te−qtdt=1/q2.

  • 当实数 p>2 时，结果为正，符合正被积函数。

    For real p>2, the result is positive, as the positive integrand requires.

  • 若漏掉性质中的负号，会得到错误的负结果。

    Omitting the minus sign in the property would produce an incorrect negative answer.

学完试一题：合上例题，自己做Try it yourself: close the worked example＋

先独立写第一步。卡住时只开一个提示，做完再核对答案。Write your first step independently. Open one hint if stuck; check the solution after attempting the problem.

求 f(t)=te−3t（t≥0）的拉普拉斯变换 F(p)=∫0∞f(t)e−ptdt，同时给出复参数 p 的收敛条件。

Find the Laplace transform of f(t)=te−3t for t≥0, using F(p)=∫0∞f(t)e−ptdt, and state its convergence condition for complex p.

提示 1：先选方法Hint 1: choose a method＋

先合并指数；真正需要积分的是 te−(p+3)t。

Combine the exponentials first; the integrand becomes te−(p+3)t.

提示 2：写第一行Hint 2: write the first line＋

令 q=p+3，要求 Req>0 才能让上端边界项消失。

Put q=p+3; require Req>0 so the upper-end boundary term vanishes.

提示 3：关键计算Hint 3: key calculation＋

分部积分，取 u=t、v=−e−qt/q。

Integrate by parts with u=t and v=−e−qt/q.

展开分步完整解答Open the full step-by-step solution＋
  1. 第 1 步Step 1

    把指数合并得到 F(p)=∫0∞te−(p+3)tdt。

    Combining exponentials gives F(p)=∫0∞te−(p+3)tdt.

  2. 第 2 步Step 2

    令 q=p+3，先要求 Req>0，保证指数压过线性增长。

    Put q=p+3 and require Req>0 so exponential decay dominates linear growth.

  3. 第 3 步Step 3

    分部积分给 ∫0∞te−qtdt=[−te−qt/q]0∞+(1/q)∫0∞e−qtdt。

    Integration by parts yields ∫0∞te−qtdt=[−te−qt/q]0∞+(1/q)∫0∞e−qtdt.

  4. 第 4 步Step 4

    首项在上述条件下为零。

    The boundary term is zero under the stated condition.

  5. 第 5 步Step 5

    剩下的指数积分为 1/q，所以 F(p)=1/(p+3)2，收敛半平面是 Rep>−3。

    The remaining exponential integral is 1/q, hence F(p)=1/(p+3)2 with convergence half-plane Rep>−3.

  6. 第 6 步Step 6

    代数表达式能延拓到更多点，但不表示原积分在那些点也收敛。

    The algebraic expression extends to more points, but that does not make the original integral converge there.

怎样检查，哪里容易错Check your result and common mistakes＋

在 p=0，结果为 1/9>0，符合正函数积分。常见错误：把衰减指数的平移写成 p−3。

At p=0 the result is 1/9>0, consistent with integrating a positive function. A common error is writing the shift as p−3 for a decaying exponential.

SECTION 2.5 · 教材 p.95SECTION 2.5 · Textbook p.95

拉普拉斯变换解常微分方程Solving ordinary differential equations with Laplace transforms

练习这一节 →Practice this section →
知识点 Concept 理解后再记忆Understand before memorizing

拉普拉斯变换解常微分方程：为什么这样做Laplace solutions of ODEs: why the method works

先用一句话理解Begin with the idea

变换能把微分方程改写成代数方程，初值也一起进入。按“变换→解代数式→拆分→逆变换”四步做，初值不要漏。

Transform the differential equation, solve the algebraic equation, decompose it, and invert. Initial values enter the derivative transforms, so include them at the first step.

再看数学表述Open the mathematical explanation＋

把微分方程连同初值一次性变成代数方程，解出像函数后做部分分式、移位或卷积逆变换。

Transform the differential equation and initial values together into an algebraic equation. Solve for the transformed function, then invert using partial fractions, shifts, or convolution.

y′′+ay′+by=f⟹(p2+ap+b)Y=F+py(0)+y′(0)+ay(0)
使用条件When it applies

初值取 0+；分段外力可以用阶跃函数编码。

Take the initial values at 0+. Encode piecewise forcing with step functions.

展开分步证明 / 推导Open the step-by-step proof / derivation＋
  1. 第 1 步Step 1

    先给未知像命名 Y=L[y]，外力像为 F=L[f]。

    Name the unknown transform Y=L[y] and the forcing transform F=L[f].

  2. 第 2 步Step 2

    分别写 L[y′]=pY−y(0) 与 L[y′′]=p2Y−py(0)−y′(0)。

    Write L[y′]=pY−y(0) and L[y′′]=p2Y−py(0)−y′(0) separately.

  3. 第 3 步Step 3

    代入 y′′+ay′+by=f 后，左边为 p2Y−py(0)−y′(0)+apY−ay(0)+bY。

    After substitution in y′′+ay′+by=f, the left side is p2Y−py(0)−y′(0)+apY−ay(0)+bY.

  4. 第 4 步Step 4

    把含 Y 的项留在左边，其余移到右边。

    Keep terms containing Y on the left and move the others right.

  5. 第 5 步Step 5

    得到 (p2+ap+b)Y=F+py(0)+y′(0)+ay(0)。

    This gives (p2+ap+b)Y=F+py(0)+y′(0)+ay(0).

  6. 第 6 步Step 6

    这是代数方程；因式分解分母后，可用部分分式、平移或卷积逆变换。

    It is algebraic; factor the denominator and use partial fractions, shifts, or convolution to invert.

  7. 第 7 步Step 7

    逆变换后仍要代回方程、初值以及分段接续条件。

    After inversion, check the equation, initial data, and any piecewise matching conditions.

  8. 第 8 步Step 8

    变换的单射性和适用条件保证这种求解法；仅仅“形式上反变换”不能替代这些检查。

    Injectivity and applicability of the transform justify the method; a formal inverse expression alone does not replace these checks.

做一道简单例题：按步骤看计算Worked example: follow each calculation＋
题目Problem

用拉普拉斯变换解初值问题 y′(t)+y(t)=1，y(0)=0。

Use the Laplace transform to solve the initial-value problem y′(t)+y(t)=1, y(0)=0.

已知什么Given

设 Y(p)=L[y(t)]。使用 L[y′]=pY(p)−y(0) 和 L[1]=1/p。

Let Y(p)=L[y(t)]. Use L[y′]=pY(p)−y(0) and L[1]=1/p.

要求什么Find

把微分方程变成代数方程，求出 Y(p)，再作逆变换。

Turn the differential equation into an algebraic equation, solve for Y(p), and invert the transform.

  1. 第 1 步Step 1对方程逐项变换Transform each term
    为什么这样做Why this step

    拉普拉斯变换把导数变成含 p 的代数项，并自动带入初值。

    The Laplace transform turns the derivative into an algebraic term in p and includes the initial value automatically.

    具体怎么算Calculation

    L[y′]+L[y]=L[1] 给出 pY(p)−y(0)+Y(p)=1/p。

    L[y′]+L[y]=L[1] gives pY(p)−y(0)+Y(p)=1/p.

  2. 第 2 步Step 2代入初值并解 $Y$Insert the initial value and solve for $Y$
    为什么这样做Why this step

    使用 y(0)=0 后只剩一个关于 Y(p) 的一次代数方程。

    After using y(0)=0, only a linear algebraic equation for Y(p) remains.

    具体怎么算Calculation

    pY+Y=1/p，所以 (p+1)Y=1/p，从而 Y(p)=1p(p+1)。

    pY+Y=1/p, so (p+1)Y=1/p and therefore Y(p)=1p(p+1).

  3. 第 3 步Step 3作部分分式分解Use partial fractions
    为什么这样做Why this step

    拆成变换表中的基本形式后才能直接逆变换。

    Splitting the expression into standard table entries makes inversion immediate.

    具体怎么算Calculation

    1p(p+1)=Ap+Bp+1；由 1=A(p+1)+Bp 得 A=1、B=−1。

    1p(p+1)=Ap+Bp+1; from 1=A(p+1)+Bp, obtain A=1 and B=−1.

  4. 第 4 步Step 4逐项逆变换Invert term by term
    为什么这样做Why this step

    1/p 和 1/(p+1) 分别对应常数函数和衰减指数。

    1/p and 1/(p+1) correspond to a constant and a decaying exponential.

    具体怎么算Calculation

    Y(p)=1/p−1/(p+1)，因此 y(t)=1−e−t。

    Y(p)=1/p−1/(p+1), so y(t)=1−e−t.

  5. 第 5 步Step 5代回原方程Substitute into the original problem
    为什么这样做Why this step

    逆变换后必须同时检查微分方程和初值。

    After inversion, both the differential equation and the initial value must be checked.

    具体怎么算Calculation

    y′(t)=e−t，所以 y′+y=e−t+1−e−t=1，并且 y(0)=1−1=0。

    y′(t)=e−t, so y′+y=e−t+1−e−t=1, and y(0)=1−1=0.

做完以后这样检查Check after solving

  • 把 t=0 代入得到 y(0)=0，初值满足。

    Substituting t=0 gives y(0)=0, so the initial value holds.

  • 把 y=1−e−t 代入左端得到恒等的 1。

    Substituting y=1−e−t into the left side gives the constant 1.

  • 当 t→∞ 时 y(t)→1，与方程的稳定平衡值一致。

    As t→∞, y(t)→1, matching the stable equilibrium value of the equation.

学完试一题：合上例题，自己做Try it yourself: close the worked example＋

先独立写第一步。卡住时只开一个提示，做完再核对答案。Write your first step independently. Open one hint if stuck; check the solution after attempting the problem.

用拉普拉斯变换解初值问题 y′+2y=3（t>0），y(0)=1。要求写出含初值的变换方程和部分分式。

Use the Laplace transform to solve y′+2y=3 for t>0, with y(0)=1. Show the transformed equation including the initial value and the partial fractions.

提示 1：先选方法Hint 1: choose a method＋

记 Y(p)=L[y](p)；导数变换中必须保留初值。

Write Y(p)=L[y](p); retain the initial value in the derivative transform.

提示 2：写第一行Hint 2: write the first line＋

变换方程为 pY−1+2Y=3/p。

The transformed equation is pY−1+2Y=3/p.

提示 3：关键计算Hint 3: key calculation＋

解得 Y=(p+3)/[p(p+2)]=3/(2p)−1/[2(p+2)]。

Solving gives Y=(p+3)/[p(p+2)]=3/(2p)−1/[2(p+2)].

展开分步完整解答Open the full step-by-step solution＋
  1. 第 1 步Step 1

    设 Y(p)=L[y](p)。

    Set Y(p)=L[y](p).

  2. 第 2 步Step 2

    用 L[y′]=pY−y(0)，方程变成 pY−1+2Y=3/p；常数3的变换是 3/p。

    Using L[y′]=pY−y(0) gives pY−1+2Y=3/p; the transform of the constant 3 is 3/p.

  3. 第 3 步Step 3

    合并未知量得到 (p+2)Y=1+3/p，所以 Y=(p+3)/[p(p+2)]。

    Collect terms to obtain (p+2)Y=1+3/p, hence Y=(p+3)/[p(p+2)].

  4. 第 4 步Step 4

    先把初值带进去再求逆变换，不能丢掉额外的1。

    Include the initial value before inversion; the extra 1 must remain.

  5. 第 5 步Step 5

    设部分分式为 Y=A/p+B/(p+2)。

    Write the partial fractions as Y=A/p+B/(p+2).

  6. 第 6 步Step 6

    比较分子 p+3=A(p+2)+Bp 得 A=3/2,B=−1/2。

    Comparing numerators in p+3=A(p+2)+Bp yields A=3/2,B=−1/2.

  7. 第 7 步Step 7

    逐项逆变换，最终 y(t)=3/2−(1/2)e−2t。

    Invert term by term to get y(t)=3/2−(1/2)e−2t.

  8. 第 8 步Step 8

    它从初值1逐渐趋向常数解 3/2。

    It starts at 1 and approaches the constant solution 3/2.

怎样检查，哪里容易错Check your result and common mistakes＋

代回得 y′=e−2t，故 y′+2y=3；同时 y(0)=1。两项都检查才完成初值题。

Substitution gives y′=e−2t, so y′+2y=3; also y(0)=1. Check both the equation and the initial value.

傅里叶级数Fourier series

6 道主编号题6 numbered exercises
习题 2.1 · 1Exercise 2.1 · 1教材 p.69 / PDF p.78Textbook p.69 / PDF p.78条件 / 勘误Conditions / correction

绝对值三角函数Trigonometric functions with absolute values

将下列周期函数展开为傅里叶级数：(1) f(x)=|cosπx|；(2) f(x)=sin(πx/l)+|sin(πx/l)|，l>0。

Expand these periodic functions in Fourier series: (1) f(x)=|cosπx|; (2) f(x)=sin(πx/l)+|sin(πx/l)|, l>0.

读题注意Read this first

第二问的原函数含非零奇部分，正弦系数 b1=1。公开参考图片将所有 bn 写为零，漏掉了这一项。

The second function has a nonzero odd part, with sine coefficient b1=1. The public reference image labels every bn as zero and omits this term.

这道题到底要什么What must you find?

把带绝对值的波形，拆成平均值与一串正弦、余弦。

Build the absolute-value waveform from an average and sine/cosine components.

凭什么选这个方法Why this method?

绝对值会把负半波翻上来，可能缩短周期。第二问还有一个原来的正弦，不能把它丢掉。

Absolute value flips negative half-waves upward and can shorten the period. Part (2) also contains an original sine term that must remain.

基础运算卡住时，先补这一项：If the basic calculation is unfamiliar, practice: 分部积分Integration by parts · 正交投影Orthogonal projection

零基础逐步讲解：一次只做一步Beginner walkthrough: one step at a time＋

先不要抄最终答案。看完当前一步，在纸上写完，再点“下一步”。Do not copy the final answer. Complete the current step on paper before choosing Next step.

  1. 第 1 步Step 1
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    第一问先确定周期：绝对值把负半波翻上来，所以周期是 1，基函数用 cos(2nπx)。

    For (1), absolute value flips negative half-waves upward, giving period 1 and basis cos(2nπx).

    函数为偶函数，正弦系数全为零。

    Evenness makes every sine coefficient zero.

  2. 第 2 步Step 2
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    在 [−1/2,1/2] 内绝对值可去掉。

    On [−1/2,1/2], remove the absolute value.

    先算 a0=2∫−1/21/2cos(πx)dx=4/π；级数常数项是 a0/2=2/π。

    Calculate a0=2∫−1/21/2cos(πx)dx=4/π; the series constant is a0/2=2/π.

  3. 第 3 步Step 3
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    用 2cosAcosB=cos(A−B)+cos(A+B) 拆开 an=4∫01/2cos(πx)cos(2nπx)dx，得到 an=4(−1)n+1/[π(4n2−1)]。

    Use 2cosAcosB=cos(A−B)+cos(A+B) in an=4∫01/2cos(πx)cos(2nπx)dx to obtain an=4(−1)n+1/[π(4n2−1)].

  4. 第 4 步Step 4
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    第二问令 θ=πx/l。

    For (2), put θ=πx/l.

    只对 |sinθ| 求系数：常数项为 2/π；周期 π 让奇数次系数为零，偶数次为 a2n=−4/[π(4n2−1)]。

    Expand only |sinθ|: its constant is 2/π; period π removes odd-index terms, and a2n=−4/[π(4n2−1)].

  5. 第 5 步Step 5
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    将上一步的余弦级数加上题目原有的 sinθ，再把 θ 换回 πx/l。

    Add the original sinθ to that cosine series and replace θ by πx/l.

    因此第二问仍有 b1=1，不能把所有正弦项删掉。

    Thus (2) retains b1=1; do not delete every sine term.

做完先别看答案，自己检查Check your work before opening the answer

第二问的全部正弦系数都为零吗？

Do all sine coefficients vanish in part (2)?

核对这个小问题Check this answer

不是，b1=1。

No. b1=1.

只看起手提示Show only a starting hint＋

(1)取周期 1；(2)令 θ=πx/l，分别处理 sinθ 与 |sinθ|。

For (1), use period 1. For (2), put θ=πx/l and treat sinθ and |sinθ| separately.

参考完整解答：先看分步讲解再打开Full reference solution: use after the guided steps＋
整道题的路线Plan for the whole problem

绝对值会改变周期；先按偶性求绝对值部分，再将已知的正弦项加回来。

An absolute value can change the period. Use evenness to expand the absolute-value part, then add the known sine term back.

把计算一行一行写出来Write the calculation line by line

  1. 第 1 步Step 1

    (1)函数为偶函数且周期 1。

    (1) The function is even and has period 1.

  2. 第 2 步Step 2

    a0=2∫−1/21/2cosπxdx=4/π。

  3. 第 3 步Step 3

    用积化和差算得

    Product-to-sum identities give

    an=4∫01/2cosπxcos2nπxdx=4(−1)n+1π(4n2−1),bn=0.
    故
    an=4∫01/2cosπxcos2nπxdx=4(−1)n+1π(4n2−1),bn=0.
    Hence
    |cosπx|=2π+4π∑n=1∞(−1)n+1cos2nπx4n2−1.
    (2)对
    |cosπx|=2π+4π∑n=1∞(−1)n+1cos2nπx4n2−1.
    (2) For
    |sinθ|，偶性给
    |sinθ|, evenness gives
    bn=0，并且只有偶次余弦项：
    bn=0 and only even-index cosine terms remain:
    a0=4/π，
    a0=4/π,
    a2n=−4/[π(4n2−1)]。
    a2n=−4/[π(4n2−1)].
  4. 第 4 步Step 4

    原函数还包含 sinθ，因此

    The original function also contains sinθ, so

    f(x)=2π+sinπxl−4π∑n=1∞cos(2nπx/l)4n2−1.
    两式处处连续，级数均收敛到原函数。
    f(x)=2π+sinπxl−4π∑n=1∞cos(2nπx/l)4n2−1.
    Both functions are continuous everywhere, and their series converge to their function values.
最后答案Final answer

(1) 2/π+(4/π)∑n≥1(−1)n+1cos2nπx/(4n2−1)；(2) 2/π+sin(πx/l)−(4/π)∑n≥1cos(2nπx/l)/(4n2−1)。

这一类题的答题套路与易错点Reusable method and common mistakes＋

可复用步骤

Reusable steps

绝对值分段化 → 找最小周期/奇偶 → 积化和差 → 合并已知频率。

Remove the absolute value piecewise → find the fundamental period and parity → use product-to-sum → combine known frequencies.

易错点

Common mistakes

第(2)项整体不是偶函数，不能把所有 bn 判为零；其 b1=1。

The complete function in (2) is not even. Not all bn vanish; its coefficient is b1=1.

习题 2.1 · 2Exercise 2.1 · 2教材 p.70 / PDF p.79Textbook p.70 / PDF p.79

恒等式与泊松核展开Identities and a Poisson-kernel expansion

将下列周期函数展开为傅里叶级数：(1) f(x)=cos2x；(2) f(x)=1/[1+12sinx]。

Expand these periodic functions in Fourier series: (1) f(x)=cos2x; (2) f(x)=1/[1+12sinx].

这道题到底要什么What must you find?

用恒等式或几何级数，避免硬算一长串系数积分。

Use identities or geometric series instead of calculating many coefficient integrals.

凭什么选这个方法Why this method?

平方余弦能降幂；三角函数在分母时，试着平移角度，配成已知的泊松核。

A squared cosine has a power-reduction identity. A trigonometric denominator suggests a phase shift and a Poisson kernel.

零基础逐步讲解：一次只做一步Beginner walkthrough: one step at a time＋

  1. 第 1 步Step 1
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    第一问先用降幂公式 cos2x=(1+cos2x)/2。

    For (1), use cos2x=(1+cos2x)/2.

    它已经是傅里叶级数：常数 1/2，二次余弦系数 1/2，其余为零。

    This is already a Fourier series: constant 1/2, second cosine coefficient 1/2, and all other coefficients zero.

  2. 第 2 步Step 2
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    第二问令 t=x−π/2，则 sinx=cost；目标变成展开 1/(1+12cost)。

    For (2), set t=x−π/2, so sinx=cost.

    The target is now 1/(1+12cost).

  3. 第 3 步Step 3
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    准备配成泊松核的分母。

    令 −2r/(1+r2)=1/2，整理成 r2+4r+1=0；选 r=3−2，因为只有它满足 |r|<1。

    Match a Poisson-kernel denominator.

    Set −2r/(1+r2)=1/2, giving r2+4r+1=0.

    Choose r=3−2, the only root with |r|<1.

  4. 第 4 步Step 4
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    把两个几何级数相加，使用 1+2∑n≥1rncos(nt)=(1−r2)/(1−2rcost+r2)；这里的收敛由 |r|<1 保证。

    Add the two geometric series to use 1+2∑n≥1rncos(nt)=(1−r2)/(1−2rcost+r2); |r|<1 guarantees convergence.

  5. 第 5 步Step 5
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    补回分母的常数倍 (1+r2)/(1−r2)=2/3，再换回 t=x−π/2。

    Restore the factor (1+r2)/(1−r2)=2/3 and substitute t=x−π/2.

    若要求标准正弦余弦形式，再展开 cos[n(x−π/2)]。

    If standard sine/cosine form is required, expand cos[n(x−π/2)].

为什么不能选模大于 1 的几何公比？

Why reject a geometric ratio with modulus greater than one?

核对这个小问题Check this answer

因为对应级数不收敛。

The corresponding series does not converge.

只看起手提示Show only a starting hint＋

令 q=2−3，r=−q，利用 1+2∑n≥1rncosnt=(1−r2)/(1−2rcost+r2)。

Set q=2−3 and r=−q, and use 1+2∑n≥1rncosnt=(1−r2)/(1−2rcost+r2).

整道题的路线Plan for the whole problem

第(1)题用降幂；第(2)题通过相位平移把分母变成 1+12cost，再配成泊松核。

Reduce powers in (1). In (2), use a phase shift to put the denominator into the form 1+12cost, then match the Poisson kernel.

把计算一行一行写出来Write the calculation line by line

  1. 第 1 步Step 1

    (1)降幂立即给出 cos2x=(1+cos2x)/2。

    (1) Power reduction immediately gives cos2x=(1+cos2x)/2. (2) Put t=x−π/2, giving sinx=cost.

  2. 第 2 步Step 2

    (2)令 t=x−π/2，则 sinx=cost。

    Choose r=3−2, which satisfies −2r/(1+r2)=1/2 and |r|<1.

  3. 第 3 步Step 3

    选 r=3−2，满足 −2r/(1+r2)=1/2，且 |r|<1。

    Add a geometric series and its conjugate:

    1+2∑n=1∞rncosnt=1−r21−2rcost+r2.
    Since (1+r2)/(1−r2)=2/3,
    11+12sinx=23[1+2∑n=1∞(3−2)ncosn(x−π2)].
    This is a valid Fourier series in phase form.
  4. 第 4 步Step 4

    由几何级数与其共轭相加，

    1+2∑n=1∞rncosnt=1−r21−2rcost+r2.
    又 (1+r2)/(1−r2)=2/3，故
    11+12sinx=23[1+2∑n=1∞(3−2)ncosn(x−π2)].
    这是合法的相位形式傅里叶级数；若要标准形式，再用 cosn(x−π/2)=cosnxcos(nπ/2)+sinnxsin(nπ/2) 拆开。

    For the standard sine-cosine form, split it using cosn(x−π/2)=cosnxcos(nπ/2)+sinnxsin(nπ/2).

最后答案Final answer

(1) 12+12cos2x；(2) 23[1+2∑n≥1(3−2)ncosn(x−π/2)]。

这一类题的答题套路与易错点Reusable method and common mistakes＋

可复用步骤

Reusable steps

低阶三角式先用恒等式；有理三角式尝试相位平移与几何级数核。

Try identities first for low-degree trigonometric expressions. For rational trigonometric expressions, try a phase shift and a geometric-series kernel.

易错点

Common mistakes

配根时取绝对值小于 1 的根，另一个根不能用于收敛的几何级数。

Choose the root with modulus less than 1. The other root cannot give a convergent geometric series.

周期锯齿波A periodic sawtooth wave

f 的周期为 2l，在 [0,2l) 上 f(x)=x。求傅里叶级数。

f has period 2l and equals f(x)=x on [0,2l). Find its Fourier series.

读题注意Read this first

在本站 a0/2 的 Fourier 级数记法下，a0=2l、bn=−2l/(nπ)。公开参考图片的正弦系数少了因子 2；常数项的记法不同需先统一。

With this site's Fourier-series convention a0/2, the coefficients are a0=2l and bn=−2l/(nπ). The public reference image misses a factor two in the sine coefficient. First align conventions for the constant term.

这道题到底要什么What must you find?

把从 0 线性上升到 2l、再重复的锯齿波展开。

Expand a sawtooth that rises from zero to 2l and then repeats.

凭什么选这个方法Why this method?

题目给的一个周期是 [0,2l)。它的平均值不为零，不能当作以原点为中心的奇函数。

The given period is [0,2l). Its average is nonzero; it is not the odd sawtooth centered at the origin.

基础运算卡住时，先补这一项：If the basic calculation is unfamiliar, practice: 分部积分Integration by parts · 正交投影Orthogonal projection

零基础逐步讲解：一次只做一步Beginner walkthrough: one step at a time＋

先不要抄最终答案。看完当前一步，在纸上写完，再点“下一步”。Do not copy the final answer. Complete the current step on paper before choosing Next step.

  1. 第 1 步Step 1
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    周期为 2l，所以角频率是 nπ/l。

    Period 2l gives angular frequencies nπ/l.

    写 f=a0/2+∑n≥1[ancos(nπx/l)+bnsin(nπx/l)]。

    Write f=a0/2+∑n≥1[ancos(nπx/l)+bnsin(nπx/l)].

  2. 第 2 步Step 2
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    在题给的一个周期积分：a0=(1/l)∫02lxdx=2l。

    Integrate over the stated period: a0=(1/l)∫02lxdx=2l.

    因此常数项为 l，不是零。

    The constant term is therefore l, not zero.

  3. 第 3 步Step 3
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    记 k=nπ/l。

    余弦系数的原函数是 xsin(kx)/k+cos(kx)/k2；代入两端后相消，得到 an=0。

    Put k=nπ/l.

    For the cosine coefficient, an antiderivative is xsin(kx)/k+cos(kx)/k2.

    The endpoint contributions cancel, giving an=0.

  4. 第 4 步Step 4
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    正弦系数的原函数是 −xcos(kx)/k+sin(kx)/k2。

    For the sine coefficient, use −xcos(kx)/k+sin(kx)/k2.

    右端留下 −2l/k，再乘 1/l 得 bn=−2l/(nπ)。

    The right endpoint leaves −2l/k; multiplying by 1/l gives bn=−2l/(nπ).

  5. 第 5 步Step 5
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    将系数填回第一步。

    在区间内部级数还原 x；在周期接缝 x=2ml，左右值分别为 2l、0，所以级数和为平均值 l。

    Insert the coefficients into step 1.

    The series reproduces x in the interior.

    At a seam x=2ml, the side limits are 2l and 0, so the sum is their average l.

做完先别看答案，自己检查Check your work before opening the answer

每周期的平均值是 0 还是 l？

Is the mean over one period zero or l?

核对这个小问题Check this answer

是 l。

It is l.

只看起手提示Show only a starting hint＋

a0=2l，正弦系数的分部积分边界项不为零。

Use a0=2l. The boundary term in the integration by parts for the sine coefficient does not vanish.

参考完整解答：先看分步讲解再打开Full reference solution: use after the guided steps＋
整道题的路线Plan for the whole problem

可以在任意完整周期积分；该函数相对周期中心有一个常数平均值。

Integrate over any complete period. Relative to the center of this period, the function has a nonzero constant average.

把计算一行一行写出来Write the calculation line by line

取一个周期 [0,2l]：

a0=1l∫02lxdx=2l,an=1l∫02lxcosnπxldx=0.
分部积分得到
bn=1l[−lxnπcosnπxl+l2n2π2sinnπxl]02l=−2lnπ.
所以在 0<x<2l，
x=l−2lπ∑n=1∞1nsinnπxl.
在 x=2kl 的跳跃处，级数和为 (0+2l)/2=l。

原书把端点区间写为闭区间时，两个端点不能同时取不同值而保持周期，故这里用半开区间解释。

Choose one period [0,2l]:

a0=1l∫02lxdx=2l,an=1l∫02lxcosnπxldx=0.
Integration by parts gives
bn=1l[−lxnπcosnπxl+l2n2π2sinnπxl]02l=−2lnπ.
Thus, for 0<x<2l,
x=l−2lπ∑n=1∞1nsinnπxl.
At the jumps x=2kl, the series sum is (0+2l)/2=l.

A periodic function cannot take different endpoint values at both ends of a closed period interval.

We therefore interpret the textbook interval as half-open.

最后答案Final answer

f(x)~l−2lπ∑n≥1sin(nπx/l)/n；跳跃处和为 l。

f(x)~l−2lπ∑n≥1sin(nπx/l)/n; the sum at a jump is l.

这一类题的答题套路与易错点Reusable method and common mistakes＋

可复用步骤

Reusable steps

全周期积分 → 算平均值 → 分部积分 → 写跳跃点的收敛值。

Integrate over a full period → calculate the average → integrate by parts → state the sum at jumps.

易错点

Common mistakes

不要误用 [−l,l] 上 f=x 的奇性；那是另一条锯齿波。

Do not use the oddness of f=x on [−l,l]. That defines a different sawtooth.

两端第一类条件的正弦展开Sine expansion for zero-value conditions at both ends

在 (0,l) 上 f(x)=x，题给边界条件 f(0)=f(l)=0，求相应傅里叶级数。

On (0,l), let f(x)=x. The stated endpoint conditions are f(0)=f(l)=0. Find the corresponding Fourier series.

读题注意Read this first

端点条件用于选择延拓及本征基底。原函数 x 与规定端点值不相容时，级数在开区间或 L² 意义恢复原函数。

The endpoint conditions choose the extension and eigenfunction basis. When x is incompatible with the prescribed endpoint values, the series recovers the original function in the open interval or in the L² sense.

这道题到底要什么What must you find?

用两端为零的正弦波，在区间内部拼出直线 x。

Use sines that vanish at both ends to reconstruct x inside the interval.

凭什么选这个方法Why this method?

两端零值选择正弦基。原函数到右端趋于 l，但指定端点值是零，两件事要分开理解。

Zero-value endpoints select sine basis functions. The interior function tends to l at the right, while the prescribed endpoint value is zero; distinguish these statements.

基础运算卡住时，先补这一项：If the basic calculation is unfamiliar, practice: 分部积分Integration by parts · 正交投影Orthogonal projection

零基础逐步讲解：一次只做一步Beginner walkthrough: one step at a time＋

先不要抄最终答案。看完当前一步，在纸上写完，再点“下一步”。Do not copy the final answer. Complete the current step on paper before choosing Next step.

  1. 第 1 步Step 1
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    两端要求零值，先选 Xn(x)=sin(nπx/l)，因为每个基函数在 0 和 l 都等于零。

    Zero values at both ends suggest Xn(x)=sin(nπx/l), since each basis function vanishes at 0 and l.

  2. 第 2 步Step 2
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    把未知系数写成投影：bn=(2/l)∫0lxsin(nπx/l)dx。

    Write the projection bn=(2/l)∫0lxsin(nπx/l)dx.

    前面的 2/l 来自基函数平方积分 l/2。

    The factor 2/l is the reciprocal of the basis squared integral l/2.

  3. 第 3 步Step 3
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    记 k=nπ/l，分部积分取 u=x、dv=sin(kx)dx。

    Put k=nπ/l and integrate by parts with u=x, dv=sin(kx)dx.

    于是积分为 [−xcos(kx)/k]0l+∫0lcos(kx)/kdx。

    The integral is [−xcos(kx)/k]0l+∫0lcos(kx)/kdx.

  4. 第 4 步Step 4
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    利用 sin(nπ)=0、cos(nπ)=(−1)n，积分只剩 −l(−1)n/k。

    Use sin(nπ)=0 and cos(nπ)=(−1)n: only −l(−1)n/k remains.

    乘回 2/l，得到 bn=2l(−1)n+1/(nπ)。

    Multiply by 2/l to obtain bn=2l(−1)n+1/(nπ).

  5. 第 5 步Step 5
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    写出 x=∑n≥1bnsin(nπx/l)，适用于 0<x<l。

    Write x=∑n≥1bnsin(nπx/l) for 0<x<l.

    右端每项为零，所以端点和为零；不要把内部极限 l 与指定端点值混为一谈。

    Every term vanishes at the right endpoint, so the endpoint sum is zero; distinguish this from the interior limit l.

做完先别看答案，自己检查Check your work before opening the answer

在 x=l，正弦级数每一项是多少？

What is every sine-series term at x=l?

核对这个小问题Check this answer

都是零，所以级数和也是零。

Zero, so the series sum is zero there too.

只看起手提示Show only a starting hint＋

用 sin(nπx/l)，系数为 2l−1∫0lxsin(nπx/l)dx。

Use sin(nπx/l), with coefficients 2l−1∫0lxsin(nπx/l)dx.

参考完整解答：先看分步讲解再打开Full reference solution: use after the guided steps＋
整道题的路线Plan for the whole problem

将题给端点条件理解为选择两端零值的正弦基；函数内部仍是 x。

Interpret the endpoint conditions as selecting sine basis functions that vanish at both ends. In the interior, the function remains x.

把计算一行一行写出来Write the calculation line by line

正弦基满足两端为零。

投影系数

bn=2l∫0lxsinnπxldx=2l(−1)n+1nπ.
于是
x=2lπ∑n=1∞(−1)n+1nsinnπxl,0<x<l.
端点 0,l 上各项均为零，级数和为零。

因为内部函数的左极限 f(l−)=l，题中“f=x且两端连续零值”无法同时成立；作为内部函数的奇延拓/平方可积展开则没有矛盾，端点单点值不影响系数。

The sine basis vanishes at both ends.

Its projection coefficient is

bn=2l∫0lxsinnπxldx=2l(−1)n+1nπ.
Therefore
x=2lπ∑n=1∞(−1)n+1nsinnπxl,0<x<l.
At endpoints 0,l, every term and the series sum are zero.

The interior function has left-hand endpoint limit f(l−)=l, so the statement “f=x and continuous zero values at both ends” cannot hold simultaneously.

There is no contradiction when this is interpreted as an odd-extension or square-integrable expansion of the interior function.

Values at isolated endpoints do not change the coefficients.

最后答案Final answer

x=2lπ∑n≥1(−1)n+1sin(nπx/l)/n，0<x<l，端点级数和为 0。

x=2lπ∑n≥1(−1)n+1sin(nπx/l)/n for 0<x<l; the endpoint series sum is 0.

这一类题的答题套路与易错点Reusable method and common mistakes＋

可复用步骤

Reusable steps

第一类齐次边界 → 正弦基 → 正交投影 → 单独讨论端点。

Homogeneous value conditions → sine basis → orthogonal projection → discuss endpoints separately.

易错点

Common mistakes

不要声称展开在 x=l 收敛到 l；这里奇延拓的跳跃平均为零。

Do not say that at x=l the expansion converges to l. The odd extension has jump average zero there.

两端第二类条件的余弦展开Cosine expansion for zero-derivative conditions at both ends

在 (0,l) 上 f(x)=x，题给 f′(0)=f′(l)=0，求相应傅里叶级数。

On (0,l), let f(x)=x, with the stated conditions f′(0)=f′(l)=0. Find the corresponding Fourier series.

读题注意Read this first

原函数 x 的端点导数与指定的齐次条件不相容；不能把级数逐项求导后的端点值当成原函数的经典端点导数。

The endpoint derivatives of x are incompatible with the stated homogeneous conditions. Endpoint values of the termwise differentiated series cannot be treated as classical endpoint derivatives of the original function.

这道题到底要什么What must you find?

用两端斜率为零的余弦波，展开区间内的直线。

Expand the interior straight line using cosines with zero endpoint slopes.

凭什么选这个方法Why this method?

零导数条件选择余弦基，并且要保留常数项。函数值展开不等于导数也能在端点逐项展开。

Zero-derivative conditions select cosines, including a constant term. Expanding function values does not guarantee termwise endpoint differentiation.

  1. 第 1 步Step 1
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    零导数边界提示余弦基，写 x=a0/2+∑n≥1ancos(nπx/l)。

    Zero-derivative boundary conditions suggest cosines: write x=a0/2+∑n≥1ancos(nπx/l).

    余弦族包括常数项，不能漏掉。

    The cosine family includes a constant; retain it.

  2. 第 2 步Step 2
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    先算 a0=(2/l)∫0lxdx=l，所以平均值为 a0/2=l/2。

    First calculate a0=(2/l)∫0lxdx=l, giving average a0/2=l/2.

  3. 第 3 步Step 3
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    对一般系数记 k=nπ/l。

    For a general coefficient put k=nπ/l.

    用原函数 xsin(kx)/k+cos(kx)/k2，得到 ∫0lxcos(kx)dx=[(−1)n−1]/k2。

    The antiderivative xsin(kx)/k+cos(kx)/k2 gives ∫0lxcos(kx)dx=[(−1)n−1]/k2.

  4. 第 4 步Step 4
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    乘 2/l 后，an=2l[(−1)n−1]/(n2π2)。

    偶数次为零；令 n=2m+1，奇数次为 −4l/[(2m+1)2π2]。

    After multiplying by 2/l, an=2l[(−1)n−1]/(n2π2).

    Even indices vanish.

    For n=2m+1, the coefficient is −4l/[(2m+1)2π2].

  5. 第 5 步Step 5
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    填回级数并保留 l/2。

    Insert the coefficients and keep l/2.

    这能还原函数值，却不能据此在端点逐项求导：偶延拓的折角使导数在那里不连续。

    The series reconstructs function values, but does not justify termwise differentiation at endpoints: the even extension has corners there.

整道题的路线Plan for the whole problem

两端零导数选余弦基；函数内部的导数为 1，所以端点条件应理解为展开基的边界类型。

Zero derivatives at both ends select a cosine basis. The interior derivative is 1, so interpret these conditions as specifying the basis boundary type.

把计算一行一行写出来Write the calculation line by line

余弦展开写作 f=a0/2+∑ancos(nπx/l)。

积分给出

a0=2l∫0lxdx=l,
an=2l∫0lxcosnπxldx=2l[(−1)n−1]n2π2.
偶数频率系数为零，因此
x=l2−4lπ2∑m=0∞cos[(2m+1)πx/l](2m+1)2,0≤x≤l.
函数值在端点可以连续还原，但不能在端点逐项求导并据此得到 f′=0；偶延拓的端点存在折角，导数不连续。

Write the cosine expansion as f=a0/2+∑ancos(nπx/l).

Integration gives

a0=2l∫0lxdx=l,
an=2l∫0lxcosnπxldx=2l[(−1)n−1]n2π2.
The even-index frequency coefficients vanish, so
x=l2−4lπ2∑m=0∞cos[(2m+1)πx/l](2m+1)2,0≤x≤l.
The series recovers continuous function values at the endpoints.

But it cannot be differentiated term by term there to conclude f′=0.

The even extension has corners at the endpoints and its derivative is discontinuous.

最后答案Final answer

x=l2−4lπ2∑m≥0cos[(2m+1)πx/l]/(2m+1)2。

这一类题的答题套路与易错点Reusable method and common mistakes＋

可复用步骤

Reusable steps

第二类齐次边界 → 余弦基且保留常数模态 → 分部积分两次。

Homogeneous derivative conditions → cosine basis, including the constant mode → integrate by parts twice.

易错点

Common mistakes

常数项是 a0/2；函数展开成立不代表端点可逐项求导。

The constant term is a0/2. A valid function expansion does not guarantee term-by-term differentiation at an endpoint.

左零导数右零值的混合展开A mixed expansion: zero derivative at the left, zero value at the right

在 (0,l) 上 f(x)=x，题给 f′(0)=f(l)=0，求相应傅里叶级数。

On (0,l), let f(x)=x, with the stated conditions f′(0)=f(l)=0. Find the corresponding Fourier series.

读题注意Read this first

初始函数与端点条件不相容时，按开区间或 L² 展开理解；端点及逐项求导需分别讨论。

If the initial function and endpoint conditions are incompatible, interpret the expansion on the open interval or in L². Discuss endpoint values and termwise differentiation separately.

这道题到底要什么What must you find?

找到同时满足“左边零斜率、右边零值”的波，再展开 x。

Find waves satisfying a zero left slope and zero right value, then expand x.

凭什么选这个方法Why this method?

两端条件不同，整数频率不一定合适。先选形状，再定频率。

Different endpoint types do not generally use integer frequencies. Choose the shape first, then its allowed frequencies.

基础运算卡住时，先补这一项：If the basic calculation is unfamiliar, practice: 分部积分Integration by parts · 正交投影Orthogonal projection

零基础逐步讲解：一次只做一步Beginner walkthrough: one step at a time＋

先不要抄最终答案。看完当前一步，在纸上写完，再点“下一步”。Do not copy the final answer. Complete the current step on paper before choosing Next step.

  1. 第 1 步Step 1
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    先用左端条件选形状：X′(0)=0 适合 X(x)=cos(kx)，因为导数 −ksin(kx) 在零点消失。

    Use the left condition to choose a shape: X′(0)=0 suggests X(x)=cos(kx) because its derivative −ksin(kx) vanishes at zero.

  2. 第 2 步Step 2
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    再用右端条件选频率：X(l)=0 给出 cos(kl)=0，所以 kn=(n+1/2)π/l，从 n=0 开始。

    Use the right condition to choose frequencies: X(l)=0 gives cos(kl)=0, so kn=(n+1/2)π/l, starting at n=0.

  3. 第 3 步Step 3
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    每个基函数平方积分为 l/2，故 cn=(2/l)∫0lxcos(knx)dx。

    Each squared basis integral is l/2, hence cn=(2/l)∫0lxcos(knx)dx.

    用原函数 xsin(knx)/kn+cos(knx)/kn2。

    Use antiderivative xsin(knx)/kn+cos(knx)/kn2.

  4. 第 4 步Step 4
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    代入 sin(knl)=(−1)n、cos(knl)=0；下端的 cos0=1 也要减去，得到 cn=2(−1)n/kn−2/(lkn2)。

    Insert sin(knl)=(−1)n and cos(knl)=0.

    Subtract the lower-end contribution cos0=1 too, obtaining cn=2(−1)n/kn−2/(lkn2).

  5. 第 5 步Step 5
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    写 x=∑n≥0cncos(knx)，这是内部展开。

    Write x=∑n≥0cncos(knx) as an interior expansion.

    右端每项为零，不能要求它在那里同时等于内部极限 l。

    Every term vanishes at the right endpoint; do not also require the endpoint sum to equal the interior limit l.

这里应选整数频率还是半整数频率？

Are the allowed frequencies integer or half-integer here?

核对这个小问题Check this answer

半整数频率 kn=(n+1/2)π/l。

Half-integer: kn=(n+1/2)π/l.

只看起手提示Show only a starting hint＋

令 kn=(n+1/2)π/l，Xn=cosknx，n=0,1,…。

Set kn=(n+1/2)π/l, Xn=cosknx, n=0,1,….

整道题的路线Plan for the whole problem

求满足 X′(0)=X(l)=0 的本征函数，得到半整数余弦基。

Find eigenfunctions satisfying X′(0)=X(l)=0. This produces a half-integer cosine basis.

把计算一行一行写出来Write the calculation line by line

由 X′(0)=0 取余弦；X(l)=0 要求 cosknl=0，所以 kn=(n+1/2)π/l。

范数 ∫0lXn2dx=l/2。

因此

cn=2l∫0lxcosknxdx=2l[xsinknxkn+cosknxkn2]0l=2(−1)nkn−2lkn2.
故
x=∑n=0∞[2(−1)nkn−2lkn2]cosknx,0<x<l.
在 x=l 各项为零。

题给端点条件与内部 x 的连续延拓不相容，应理解为上述混合边界基上的内部/L2展开。

The condition X′(0)=0 selects cosine.

The condition X(l)=0 requires cosknl=0, giving kn=(n+1/2)π/l.

The squared norm is ∫0lXn2dx=l/2.

Thus

cn=2l∫0lxcosknxdx=2l[xsinknxkn+cosknxkn2]0l=2(−1)nkn−2lkn2.
and
x=∑n=0∞[2(−1)nkn−2lkn2]cosknx,0<x<l.
At x=l, every term is zero.

The prescribed endpoint conditions are incompatible with a continuous extension of the interior function x.

Interpret this as an interior or L² expansion in the mixed-boundary basis.

最后答案Final answer

cn=2(−1)n/kn−2/(lkn2)，kn=(n+1/2)π/l，x=∑cncosknx（内部）。

cn=2(−1)n/kn−2/(lkn2), kn=(n+1/2)π/l, x=∑cncosknx in the interior.

可复用步骤

Reusable steps

混合边界先解本征值方程，再投影；不要直接套整数频率。

For mixed boundaries, solve the eigenvalue condition before projecting. Do not assume integer frequencies.

易错点

Common mistakes

本题是左导数右函数值为零，应选半整数余弦而非半整数正弦。

The derivative is zero on the left and the value is zero on the right. Use half-integer cosines, not half-integer sines.

矩形脉冲变换Transform of a rectangular pulse

f(x)=1（−a≤x≤a），其余为 0，a>0。求傅里叶变换。

Let f(x)=1 for −a≤x≤a and 0 elsewhere, with a>0. Find its Fourier transform.

这道题到底要什么What must you find?

求一个宽度 2a、高度 1 的矩形脉冲含有哪些频率。

Find the frequency content of a height-one rectangle of width 2a.

凭什么选这个方法Why this method?

函数只在有限区间非零，所以全轴积分只剩 [−a,a]。

The function is nonzero only on a finite interval, so the whole-line integral reduces to [−a,a].

基础运算卡住时，先补这一项：If the basic calculation is unfamiliar, practice: 分部积分Integration by parts

零基础逐步讲解：一次只做一步Beginner walkthrough: one step at a time＋

先不要抄最终答案。看完当前一步，在纸上写完，再点“下一步”。Do not copy the final answer. Complete the current step on paper before choosing Next step.

  1. 第 1 步Step 1
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    先写本章正变换约定 F(k)=∫−∞∞f(x)e−ikxdx。

    Write the chapter convention F(k)=∫−∞∞f(x)e−ikxdx.

    k 是频率变量，x 是积分变量。

    Here k is the frequency variable and x is integrated out.

  2. 第 2 步Step 2
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    区间外函数为零，因此只留下 F(k)=∫−aae−ikxdx，不用分三段分别计算零积分。

    The function is zero outside its support, leaving F(k)=∫−aae−ikxdx; there is no need to calculate zero pieces separately.

  3. 第 3 步Step 3
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    展开 e−ikx=cos(kx)−isin(kx)。

    Expand e−ikx=cos(kx)−isin(kx).

    正弦是奇函数，在对称区间相消，所以 F(k)=2∫0acos(kx)dx。

    The odd sine cancels on the symmetric interval, giving F(k)=2∫0acos(kx)dx.

  4. 第 4 步Step 4
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    当 k≠0，余弦的原函数是 sin(kx)/k，代入端点得 F(k)=2sin(ak)/k。

    For k≠0, integrate cosine as sin(kx)/k.

    The endpoints give F(k)=2sin(ak)/k.

  5. 第 5 步Step 5
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    另查 k=0：直接积分得 F(0)=2a，也等于矩形面积。

    Check k=0 separately: direct integration gives F(0)=2a, the rectangle area.

    把这个值补到公式的可去点，而不是写成无穷大。

    Fill this removable point with that value instead of calling it infinite.

做完先别看答案，自己检查Check your work before opening the answer

零频值 F(0) 是多少？

What is the zero-frequency value F(0)?

核对这个小问题Check this answer

2a。

只看起手提示Show only a starting hint＋

直接计算 ∫−aae−ikxdx，k=0 用极限。

Calculate ∫−aae−ikxdx directly. Use a limit at k=0.

参考完整解答：先看分步讲解再打开Full reference solution: use after the guided steps＋
整道题的路线Plan for the whole problem

积分区间由函数支集缩短。

The function is zero outside its support, so the integration interval shrinks to that support.

把计算一行一行写出来Write the calculation line by line

  1. 第 1 步Step 1

    按约定

    With our convention,

    F(k)=∫−aae−ikxdx=eika−e−ikaik=2sinakk(k≠0).
    由
    F(k)=∫−aae−ikxdx=eika−e−ikaik=2sinakk(k≠0).
    Since
    sinak/k→a，补上
    sinak/k→a, fill in
    F(0)=2a。
    F(0)=2a.
  2. 第 2 步Step 2

    也可用偶性写成 2∫0acoskxdx。

    Evenness also gives 2∫0acoskxdx.

最后答案Final answer

F(k)=2sin(ak)/k，连续延拓 F(0)=2a。

F(k)=2sin(ak)/k, with continuous extension F(0)=2a.

这一类题的答题套路与易错点Reusable method and common mistakes＋

可复用步骤

Reusable steps

先找支集 → 利用奇偶 → 计算有限区间积分 → 补可去奇点。

Locate the support → use parity → integrate over the finite interval → fill in removable singularities.

易错点

Common mistakes

F(0) 等于原函数总面积，不是零。

F(0) equals the total area of the original function, not zero.

sinc与矩形谱的对偶Duality between sinc and a rectangular spectrum

求 f(x)=sin(ax)/x 的傅里叶变换，并与前题比较（a>0，x=0 取连续值 a）。

Find the Fourier transform of f(x)=sin(ax)/x and compare it with the previous exercise. Assume a>0 and take the continuous value a at x=0.

这道题到底要什么What must you find?

说明 sinc 形状的函数对应一个矩形频谱。

Show that a sinc-shaped function has a rectangular spectrum.

凭什么选这个方法Why this method?

上一题已经建立“矩形 → sinc”。现在可以反过来用，但要带上逆变换的系数。

The preceding exercise gives “rectangle → sinc.” Reverse that relationship while retaining the inverse-transform factor.

基础运算卡住时，先补这一项：If the basic calculation is unfamiliar, practice: 分部积分Integration by parts

零基础逐步讲解：一次只做一步Beginner walkthrough: one step at a time＋

先不要抄最终答案。看完当前一步，在纸上写完，再点“下一步”。Do not copy the final answer. Complete the current step on paper before choosing Next step.

  1. 第 1 步Step 1
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    原函数实且偶，所以频谱也实且偶。

    The original function is real and even, so its spectrum is too.

    先把定义化为 F(k)=2∫0∞sin(ax)cos(kx)/xdx。

    Reduce the definition to F(k)=2∫0∞sin(ax)cos(kx)/xdx.

  2. 第 2 步Step 2
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    用 2sinAcosB=sin(A+B)+sin(A−B)，得到两个正弦积分，其频率分别为 a+k 和 a−k。

    Use 2sinAcosB=sin(A+B)+sin(A−B) to obtain two sine integrals with frequencies a+k and a−k.

  3. 第 3 步Step 3
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    套用 ∫0∞sin(bx)/xdx=(π/2)sgnb；这里正频率给 π/2、负频率给 −π/2、零频率给零。

    Use ∫0∞sin(bx)/xdx=(π/2)sgnb: positive frequency gives π/2, negative gives −π/2, and zero gives zero.

  4. 第 4 步Step 4
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    分区判断符号：|k|<a 时两个频率都正，和为 π；|k|>a 时一正一负，和为零。

    Check signs by region: for |k|<a, both frequencies are positive and sum to π; for |k|>a, their signs differ and the sum is zero.

  5. 第 5 步Step 5
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    在 k=±a，一个频率为零，另一个为正，因此取 π/2。

    At k=±a, one frequency is zero and the other positive, giving π/2.

    这就是矩形谱的边界半值，也检验了前题的矩形与 sinc 对偶关系。

    This is the rectangular spectrum boundary half-value and checks the preceding rectangle–sinc duality.

做完先别看答案，自己检查Check your work before opening the answer

频谱边界 |k|=a 取内部值还是一半？

At the spectral boundary |k|=a, use the interior value or half of it?

核对这个小问题Check this answer

取一半，即 π/2。

Half: π/2.

只看起手提示Show only a starting hint＋

前题 1[−a,a] 的变换为 2sin(ax)/x，应用对偶性。

In the previous exercise, 1[−a,a] transforms to 2sin(ax)/x. Apply duality.

参考完整解答：先看分步讲解再打开Full reference solution: use after the guided steps＋
整道题的路线Plan for the whole problem

利用矩形脉冲变换的逆变换，或拆成狄利克雷积分。

Use the inverse transform of the rectangular-pulse result, or split into Dirichlet integrals.

把计算一行一行写出来Write the calculation line by line

先用偶性消去虚部：

F(k)=2∫0∞sinaxcoskxxdx=∫0∞sin[(a+k)x]+sin[(a−k)x]xdx.
利用 ∫0∞sin(bx)/xdx=(π/2)sgnb（b=0 时为零），得到 F=π（|k|<a）、0（|k|>a）、π/2（|k|=a）。

这正是前题“矩形↔sinc”互换，系数由逆变换的 1/(2π) 决定。

积分是条件收敛的广义傅里叶变换。

Evenness first removes the imaginary part:

F(k)=2∫0∞sinaxcoskxxdx=∫0∞sin[(a+k)x]+sin[(a−k)x]xdx.
Use ∫0∞sin(bx)/xdx=(π/2)sgnb, which is zero when b=0.

The results are F=π for |k|<a, 0 for |k|>a, and π/2 for |k|=a.

This is the interchange “rectangle ↔ sinc” from the previous exercise; the factor comes from 1/(2π) in the inverse transform.

The integral is a conditionally convergent generalized Fourier transform.

最后答案Final answer

F(k)=π1|k|<a，边界 k=±a 取 π/2。

F(k)=π1|k|<a; take π/2 at the boundary k=±a.

这一类题的答题套路与易错点Reusable method and common mistakes＋

可复用步骤

Reusable steps

遇到 sinax/x → 矩形谱对偶，或积化和差后用狄利克雷积分。

For sinax/x, use rectangular-spectrum duality, or a product-to-sum identity followed by the Dirichlet integral.

易错点

Common mistakes

频谱跳跃点要取半值；不应在全轴宣称绝对可积。

At a spectral jump, use the half-value. Do not claim absolute integrability on the whole line.

习题 2.2 · 3Exercise 2.2 · 3教材 p.75 / PDF p.84Textbook p.75 / PDF p.84

双边指数函数A two-sided exponential

求 f(x)=e−|x| 的傅里叶变换。

Find the Fourier transform of f(x)=e−|x|.

这道题到底要什么What must you find?

求一个左右对称、向两边衰减的指数函数的频谱。

Find the spectrum of a symmetric exponential decaying in both directions.

凭什么选这个方法Why this method?

原函数实且偶，变换应实且偶。先利用这一点，少算一半积分。

A real even original function has a real even transform. Use that symmetry to halve the work.

基础运算卡住时，先补这一项：If the basic calculation is unfamiliar, practice: 分部积分Integration by parts

零基础逐步讲解：一次只做一步Beginner walkthrough: one step at a time＋

先不要抄最终答案。看完当前一步，在纸上写完，再点“下一步”。Do not copy the final answer. Complete the current step on paper before choosing Next step.

  1. 第 1 步Step 1
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    先去掉绝对值的不确定性：正半轴上 e−|x|=e−x，负半轴上是 ex；函数关于原点对称。

    Resolve the absolute value first: e−|x|=e−x on the positive half-line and ex on the negative half-line; the function is symmetric.

  2. 第 2 步Step 2
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    实偶性让虚部相消，写 F(k)=2∫0∞e−xcos(kx)dx。

    Real evenness cancels the imaginary part, so F(k)=2∫0∞e−xcos(kx)dx.

  3. 第 3 步Step 3
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    把余弦看成复指数的实部，先算 J=∫0∞e−(1−ik)xdx=1/(1−ik)；指数的实部为负，所以无穷远边界项为零。

    View cosine as the real part of a complex exponential.

    First calculate J=∫0∞e−(1−ik)xdx=1/(1−ik); the negative real exponent makes the infinite-end term vanish.

  4. 第 4 步Step 4
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    有理化 1/(1−ik)=(1+ik)/(1+k2)，因此 ReJ=1/(1+k2)；乘回 2 得 F(k)=2/(1+k2)。

    Rationalize 1/(1−ik)=(1+ik)/(1+k2), so ReJ=1/(1+k2).

    Restore the factor 2 to get F(k)=2/(1+k2).

  5. 第 5 步Step 5
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    检查两点：结果应为实偶函数；F(0)=2 应等于原函数面积。

    Check two features: the result should be real and even, and F(0)=2 should equal the original area.

    两项都符合，符号与系数可信。

    Both checks confirm the sign and prefactor.

做完先别看答案，自己检查Check your work before opening the answer

负半轴上的 e−|x| 等于 e−x 吗？

Is e−|x|=e−x on the negative half-line?

核对这个小问题Check this answer

不等于。负半轴是 ex。

No. There it is ex.

只看起手提示Show only a starting hint＋

把 2∫0∞e−xcoskxdx 看成复指数积分的实部。

View 2∫0∞e−xcoskxdx as the real part of a complex-exponential integral.

参考完整解答：先看分步讲解再打开Full reference solution: use after the guided steps＋
整道题的路线Plan for the whole problem

偶函数只剩余弦积分。

Evenness leaves only a cosine integral.

把计算一行一行写出来Write the calculation line by line

由偶性，

F(k)=2∫0∞e−xcoskxdx=2Re∫0∞e−(1−ik)xdx=2Re11−ik=21+k2.
在 k=0 得 2，与 ∫e−|x|dx=2 一致；结果为实偶函数，符合原函数实偶性。

Using evenness,

F(k)=2∫0∞e−xcoskxdx=2Re∫0∞e−(1−ik)xdx=2Re11−ik=21+k2.
At k=0 this gives 2, agreeing with ∫e−|x|dx=2.

The transform is real and even, as expected for a real even original function.

最后答案Final answer

F(k)=2/(1+k2)。

Find the Fourier transform of f(x)=e−x2.

证明高斯函数变换后仍然是高斯形状，并算准系数。

Prove that a Gaussian transforms into another Gaussian and determine its prefactor.

凭什么选这个方法Why this method?

直接积分带复指数较难，但对频率求导会出现 x，与高斯自身的导数相连。

Direct integration with a complex exponential is awkward. Differentiating in frequency introduces x, which relates to the Gaussian's derivative.

零基础逐步讲解：一次只做一步Beginner walkthrough: one step at a time＋

先不要抄最终答案。看完当前一步，在纸上写完，再点“下一步”。Do not copy the final answer. Complete the current step on paper before choosing Next step.

  1. 第 1 步Step 1
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    记 F(k)=∫−∞∞e−x2e−ikxdx。

    Let F(k)=∫−∞∞e−x2e−ikxdx.

    不硬算这个复积分，改为寻找 F 满足的微分方程。

    Instead of directly evaluating the complex integral, find a differential equation for F.

  2. 第 2 步Step 2
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    对 k 求导，指数产生 −ix，因此 F′(k)=−i∫xe−x2e−ikxdx。

    Differentiate in k: the exponential contributes −ix, so F′(k)=−i∫xe−x2e−ikxdx.

    高斯衰减保证这一步合法。

    Gaussian decay justifies this step.

  3. 第 3 步Step 3
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    用 xe−x2=−12(d/dx)e−x2，再分部积分。

    Use xe−x2=−12(d/dx)e−x2 and integrate by parts.

    两端高斯为零，留下 F′(k)=(i/2)(ik)F(k)=−kF(k)/2。

    The Gaussian vanishes at both ends, leaving F′(k)=(i/2)(ik)F(k)=−kF(k)/2.

  4. 第 4 步Step 4
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    解一阶方程得 F(k)=Ce−k2/4。

    Solve the first-order equation to get F(k)=Ce−k2/4.

    令 k=0，原积分变成高斯积分 F(0)=π，于是 C=π。

    At k=0, the original integral is Gaussian: F(0)=π, fixing C=π.

  5. 第 5 步Step 5
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    写出 F(k)=πe−k2/4。

    它实且偶，并在频率远离零时衰减；若算出增长的指数，应回查分部积分的负号。

    Write F(k)=πe−k2/4.

    It is real, even, and decays away from zero frequency.

    A growing exponential signals a sign error in integration by parts.

  1. 第 1 步Step 1

    设 F(k)=∫e−x2e−ikxdx。

    Let F(k)=∫e−x2e−ikxdx.

    允许在积分号下求导，因为高斯衰减足够快：

    Gaussian decay is fast enough to justify differentiation under the integral:

    F′(k)=−i∫xe−x2e−ikxdx=i2∫(e−x2)′e−ikxdx=−k2F(k).
    解为
    F′(k)=−i∫xe−x2e−ikxdx=i2∫(e−x2)′e−ikxdx=−k2F(k).
    The solution is
    F=Ce−k2/4。
    F=Ce−k2/4.

    F(0)=∫e−x2dx=π，故 C=π。

有限支集正弦A sine function with finite support

f(x)=sinx（|x|≤π），其余为 0。求傅里叶变换。

Let f(x)=sinx for |x|≤π and 0 elsewhere. Find its Fourier transform.

这道题到底要什么What must you find?

求被截在 [−π,π] 内的一段正弦的频谱。

Find the spectrum of a sine wave truncated to [−π,π].

凭什么选这个方法Why this method?

有限支集让积分区间有限；实奇函数告诉我们结果应为纯虚奇函数。

Finite support makes the interval finite. Real odd symmetry predicts a purely imaginary odd transform.

基础运算卡住时，先补这一项：If the basic calculation is unfamiliar, practice: 分部积分Integration by parts

零基础逐步讲解：一次只做一步Beginner walkthrough: one step at a time＋

先不要抄最终答案。看完当前一步，在纸上写完，再点“下一步”。Do not copy the final answer. Complete the current step on paper before choosing Next step.

  1. 第 1 步Step 1
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    只在 [−π,π] 积分。

    Integrate only over [−π,π].

    原函数实且奇，先预判频谱应纯虚且奇，作为最后的检查。

    The original function is real and odd, so expect a purely imaginary odd spectrum as a final check.

  2. 第 2 步Step 2
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    写 sinx=(eix−e−ix)/(2i)，乘上 e−ikx 后变成频率 k−1、k+1 的两个指数。

    Write sinx=(eix−e−ix)/(2i).

    Multiplication by e−ikx gives two exponentials at frequencies k−1 and k+1.

  3. 第 3 步Step 3
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    用 ∫−ππe−iqxdx=2sin(πq)/q，得到 F(k)=1i[sinπ(k−1)/(k−1)−sinπ(k+1)/(k+1)]。

    Use ∫−ππe−iqxdx=2sin(πq)/q to obtain F(k)=1i[sinπ(k−1)/(k−1)−sinπ(k+1)/(k+1)].

  4. 第 4 步Step 4
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    利用 sinπ(k±1)=−sinπk 通分，化为 F(k)=2isin(πk)/(k2−1)；它符合纯虚奇性。

    Use sinπ(k±1)=−sinπk and combine fractions to get F(k)=2isin(πk)/(k2−1), which is purely imaginary and odd.

  5. 第 5 步Step 5
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    单独检查可去点：极限给 F(1)=−iπ、F(−1)=iπ；另有 F(0)=0。

    Check removable points separately: limits give F(1)=−iπ and F(−1)=iπ; also F(0)=0.

    不能把分母为零直接解释为变换发散。

    A zero denominator alone does not imply a divergent transform.

把计算一行一行写出来Write the calculation line by line

按定义

F(k)=1i[sinπ(k−1)k−1−sinπ(k+1)k+1]=2isinπkk2−1.
k=±1 是可去奇点：直接积分或取极限得 F(1)=−iπ、F(−1)=iπ；F(0)=0。

这些值与纯虚奇性一致。

By definition,

F(k)=1i[sinπ(k−1)k−1−sinπ(k+1)k+1]=2isinπkk2−1.
The points k=±1 are removable singularities.

Direct integration or limits give F(1)=−iπ and F(−1)=iπ, while F(0)=0.

These values agree with the purely imaginary odd symmetry.

半轴零值边界与奇延拓A zero boundary on the half-line and odd extension

在 (0,∞) 上，f(x)=cosx（0<x≤π）、f(x)=0（x>π），且题给 f(0)=0。求相应傅里叶变换像函数。

On (0,∞), let f(x)=cosx for 0<x≤π and f(x)=0 for x>π, with the stated condition f(0)=0. Find the corresponding transformed function.

读题注意Read this first

半轴题面未单独规定完整的变换规范；解析给出正弦变换及奇延拓的全轴变换。在 e−ikx 的约定下，全轴结果应为负的纯虚奇函数，公开参考图片的符号相反。

The half-line question does not fully specify its transform convention. The solution gives both the sine transform and the whole-line transform of the odd extension. Under e−ikx, the latter is a negative purely imaginary odd function; the public reference image has the opposite sign.

把半轴问题接成奇函数，再分清正弦像与全轴像。

凭什么选这个方法Why this method?

零值边界适合奇延拓。负指数的全轴变换会给正弦积分带来 −2i。

A zero-value boundary suggests an odd extension. The negative-exponential whole-line transform contributes a factor −2i to the sine integral.

  1. 第 1 步Step 1
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    左端零值提示奇延拓。

    A zero left-end value suggests an odd extension.

    先定义半轴正弦像 S(k)=∫0πcosxsin(kx)dx，此时还不是全轴频谱。

    First define the half-line sine transform S(k)=∫0πcosxsin(kx)dx; this is not yet the whole-line spectrum.

  2. 第 2 步Step 2
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    用 2sin(kx)cosx=sin[(k+1)x]+sin[(k−1)x]，把乘积拆为两个能直接积分的正弦。

    Use 2sin(kx)cosx=sin[(k+1)x]+sin[(k−1)x] to split the product into two directly integrable sines.

  3. 第 3 步Step 3
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    每项用 ∫0πsin(qx)dx=[1−cos(πq)]/q，得到 S(k)=12[(1+cosπk)/(k+1)+(1+cosπk)/(k−1)]。

    For each term use ∫0πsin(qx)dx=[1−cos(πq)]/q.

    Thus S(k)=12[(1+cosπk)/(k+1)+(1+cosπk)/(k−1)].

  4. 第 4 步Step 4
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    通分得 S(k)=k(1+cosπk)/(k2−1)。

    Combine fractions: S(k)=k(1+cosπk)/(k2−1).

    若求奇延拓的全轴像，负指数约定给 F(k)=−2iS(k)；归一化正弦像则需另乘课程系数。

    For the whole-line odd extension, the negative-exponent convention gives F(k)=−2iS(k); a normalized sine transform needs its course-specific factor.

  5. 第 5 步Step 5
    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    从原积分检查 k=0,±1，值都为零。

    Check k=0,±1 using the original integral: all values are zero.

    题给的端点值与右侧极限可以不同，单点不改变积分。

    A prescribed endpoint value may differ from its right-hand limit without changing the integral.

本章负指数约定下，全轴奇延拓的像是 2iS 吗？

核对这个小问题Check this answer

不是，是 −2iS。

No. It is −2iS.

只看起手提示Show only a starting hint＋

先算 S(k)=∫0πcosxsinkxdx，奇延拓全轴像为 −2iS(k)。

参考完整解答：先看分步讲解再打开Full reference solution: use after the guided steps＋
整道题的路线Plan for the whole problem

零值边界选奇延拓。应区分半轴正弦变换和奇延拓后的全轴傅里叶变换。

A zero-value boundary selects an odd extension. Distinguish the half-line sine transform from the whole-line Fourier transform of that extension.

把计算一行一行写出来Write the calculation line by line

令奇延拓 f~(−x)=−f(x)。

由积化和差

S(k)=12∫0π[sin(k+1)x+sin(k−1)x]dx=k(1+cosπk)k2−1.
因此
F[f~](k)=−2iS(k)=−2ik(1+cosπk)k2−1.
k=0,±1 的连续延拓值均为零。

若课程采用带 2/π 的正弦变换，须把 S 乘该系数。

题给 f(0)=0 与 f(0+)=1 不连续，但单点值不改变积分；奇延拓在零点有跳跃，级数/逆变换在那里取平均值零。

题干没有指定半轴规范，所以本解明确列出两种相互对应的像函数。

Define the odd extension f~(−x)=−f(x).

Product-to-sum gives

S(k)=12∫0π[sin(k+1)x+sin(k−1)x]dx=k(1+cosπk)k2−1.
Therefore
F[f~](k)=−2iS(k)=−2ik(1+cosπk)k2−1.
The continuous values at k=0,±1 are both zero.

If the course uses the sine-transform normalization 2/π, multiply S by that factor.

The stated f(0)=0 is discontinuous with f(0+)=1, but changing a single point does not change the integral.

The odd extension has a jump at zero; its series or inverse transform takes the average, zero, there.

Since the question does not specify a half-line convention, this solution lists both corresponding transforms explicitly.

最后答案Final answer

未归一化正弦像 S(k)=k(1+cosπk)/(k2−1)；奇延拓全轴像 F(k)=−2ik(1+cosπk)/(k2−1)，可去点取零。

Unnormalized sine transform S(k)=k(1+cosπk)/(k2−1); whole-line transform of the odd extension F(k)=−2ik(1+cosπk)/(k2−1), with value zero at removable points.

    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    令 k=|k|，把球坐标极轴对准频率向量。

    这样 k·r=krcosθ，方向问题只剩一个余弦。

    Then k·r=krcosθ.

    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    先写完整体积元 d3r=r2sinθdrdθdϕ。

    The azimuthal integral gives 2π; then put μ=cosθ.

    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    极角积分为 2π∫−11e−ikrμdμ=4πsin(kr)/(kr)。

    这是径向函数变换的通用角因子。

    The polar integral is 2π∫−11e−ikrμdμ=4πsin(kr)/(kr), the general angular factor for a radial transform.

    现在只做这一件事Do only this now

    乘上 r2e−αr/r，约掉两个 r 后，得到 U^(k)=(4π/k)∫0∞e−αrsin(kr)dr。

    The exponential-sine integral is k/(α2+k2), giving U^(k)=4π/(α2+k2).

    在 k=0 补连续值 4π/α2，与直接体积分一致。

    Fill in k=0 with 4π/α2, consistent with direct spatial integration.

    记 k=|k|。

    Write k=|k|.

    球坐标角积分为

    The angular integral is

    2π∫−11e−ikrμdμ=4πsinkrkr.
    因此
    2π∫−11e−ikrμdμ=4πsinkrkr.
    Therefore
    U^(k)=4πk∫0∞e−αrsinkrdr=4πkkα2+k2=4πα2+k2.
    在
    U^(k)=4πk∫0∞e−αrsinkrdr=4πkkα2+k2=4πα2+k2.
    At
    k=0 取连续值
    k=0, the continuous value is
    4π/α2，等于全空间积分。
    4π/α2, equal to the integral over all space.
最后答案Final answer

U^(k)=4π/(|k|2+α2)。

可复用步骤

Reusable steps

三维径向函数 → 以 k 为极轴 → 角积分化为 sinc → 一维径向积分。

A radial function in three dimensions → choose k as polar axis → reduce the angular integral to sinc → evaluate the one-dimensional radial integral.

易错点

Common mistakes

体积元是 r2sinθdrdθdϕ；不能使用一维余弦变换直接替代。

The volume element is r2sinθdrdθdϕ. A one-dimensional cosine transform is not a substitute.
